3976.name: Scarlet Commander Mograine
3976.story: Renault Mograine killed his father, Alexandros Mograine, with the Ashbringer near Stratholme, after Saidan Dathrohan promised him power and prestige in the Scarlet Crusade. He was made Scarlet Commander and sent to the Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal as commander of operations. Nearly one year after the Forsaken secured the Undercity, he led the Scarlet Crusade in an all-out assault on the Forsaken and invaded the Undercity itself. He and Sally Whitemane were forced to pull back by Garek Bandarion, Dark Ranger Anya and, in Whitemane's case, Leonid Barthalomew, and the crusaders retreated to the Scarlet Monastery. In World of Warcraft he is the Scarlet Commander, a boss in the Scarlet Monastery.

appearances.role: Scarlet Crusade commander who leads the assault on the Forsaken with High Inquisitor Whitemane; the player must defeat him in the quest "The Dark Lady's Scalpel"

7937.name: High Tinker Mekkatorque
7937.story: Gelbin Mekkatorque is the High Tinker of Gnomeregan and a brilliant gnomish inventor. After the Second War, King Magni asked him for a faster solution to the slow travel to and from the north, and he prepared the schematics for the Deeprun Tram. The gnomish electorate later chose him as High Tinker, and his friend Sicco Thermaplugg became his chief advisor, though Thermaplugg coveted the role of High Tinker. In the short story Cut Short he leads the gnomes' push to retake Gnomeregan and survives Thermaplugg's trap in his old quarters. In the novels he takes part in Alliance politics, including the vote on Gilneas and the planning after the Attack on Theramore Isle.

appearances.role: Gnome engineer who keeps General Turalyon informed about the Deeprun Tram project and a problem with rats
High Tinker who leads the gnomes' push to retake Gnomeregan, survives Sicco Thermaplugg's trap in his old quarters in Sector 17 and turns his trap so that it cuts Thermaplugg in half
High Tinker of Gnomeregan who represents the gnomes at a meeting in Darnassus, makes peace with Drukan and votes to accept Gilneas into the Alliance (chapters 9, 10 and 29)
Alliance leader who plans a counterattack against the Horde blockade of Kalimdor in Stormwind after the Attack on Theramore Isle (chapter 23)
Gnome engineer who studies Azerite samples and sends Sapphronetta Flivvers to Silithus, and meets Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge (chapters 8 and 14)
Joins the Horde and Alliance leaders who meet before Garrosh Hellscream's trial and mocks Jastor Gallywix's call for compensation

3977.name: High Inquisitor Whitemane
3977.story: Sally Whitemane was a human priestess of the Light who became High Inquisitor of the Scarlet Crusade, directing its activities from the Scarlet Monastery's Cathedral. Nearly one year after the Forsaken secured the Undercity, she and Renault Mograine launched an all-out assault on the Forsaken, and Whitemane attacked the Forsaken settlements in Tirisfal Glades. She and Renault were forced to pull back by Garek Bandarion, Dark Ranger Anya and, in Whitemane's case, Leonid Barthalomew, and the crusaders retreated to the Scarlet Monastery. In World of Warcraft she is the final boss of the Scarlet Monastery.

appearances.role: Scarlet Crusade commander and enemy of the Forsaken; the player must defeat her in the quests "Our Home, Our Land" and "The Dark Lady's Scalpel"
Four Horsemen member in the short story: Darion Mograine orders her and Nazgrim to rescue Bolvar Fordragon after the Scourge slips out of control

4879.name: Ogg'marr
4879.story: Ogg'marr is an ogre butcher of the Stonemaul clan. In Warcraft III: Reforged he appears in the ogre village in Dustwallow Marsh during Old Hatreds, the mission in which Rexxar seeks the ogres' help. In World of Warcraft he is a vendor in Brackenwall Village, Dustwallow Marsh. He sells meat, drink and cooking recipes.

appearances.campaign: The Founding of Durotar (Orc bonus campaign)
appearances.role: Stonemaul ogre present in the ogre village in Dustwallow Marsh (Warcraft III: Reforged only)

8198.name: Tick
8198.story: In World of Warcraft, Tick is a bronze drake that guards the entrance to the Caverns of Time in eastern Tanaris, together with Chronalis. In Thrall: Twilight of the Aspects, she takes Thrall to meet the other dragonflights. She later carries him in the battle to retake Wyrmrest Temple from the Twilight's Hammer and returns him to the Maelstrom. In the short story Charge of the Aspects, she carries the badly wounded Zirion to Nozdormu and tells him the Infinite Dragonflight and its leader attacked Zirion.

appearances.role: Takes Thrall to meet the other dragonflights and carries him in the battle to retake Wyrmrest Temple, then returns him to the Maelstrom
Carries the badly wounded Zirion, the only survivor of Nozdormu's twelve agents sent into the past, and tells Nozdormu the Infinite Dragonflight attacked him

5137.name: Reyna Stonebranch
5137.story: Reyna Stonebranch is a dwarf herbalism trainer in the Great Forge in Ironforge. In The Shattering: Prelude to Cataclysm she followed the instructions from a tablet from Ulduar and created a liquid meant for Magni to communicate with Azeroth. Instead of communicating, Magni was turned into diamond.

appearances.role: Herbalism trainer in the Great Forge who follows instructions from a tablet from Ulduar to make a liquid meant for Magni to communicate with Azeroth

4630.name: Pozzik
4630.story: In World of Warcraft Pozzik is a goblin tinker at the Mirage Raceway in Thousand Needles, which he built with his long-time rival Fizzle Brassbolts to prove the superiority of their races' engineering. Both of them then built rocket cars and enlisted teams to drive them. The novel Traveler: The Spiral Path, set much later, records him as a member of MEGA, the Mechanical Engineers' Guild of Azeroth. There he registers and officiates the Annual Fizzle and Pozzik's Speedbarge Boat Race, and Gazlowe pays him to confirm that the pilots switched only after the race.

appearances.role: Cofounder of the Speedbarge who registers and officiates the Annual Boat Race; Gazlowe pays him to verify that Aram and Hotfix switched pilots only after the race; a member of the Mechanical Engineers' Guild of Azeroth (MEGA)

6928.name: Innkeeper Grosk
6928.story: In the novel Jaina Proudmoore: Tides of War, Grosk served drinks to Malkorok and his Kor'kron soldiers, then disappeared. Kelantir Bloodblade and Frandis Farley were killed when Kor'kron grenades blew up the inn, and Grosk claimed he knew nothing about it. In World of Warcraft he is an innkeeper in Razor Hill, Durotar.

appearances.role: Innkeeper of the inn in Razor Hill who serves Malkorok and his Kor'kron soldiers, vanishes during their visit, and the inn explodes after they leave
Shown in a vision at Garrosh's trial, where he maintains that he knew nothing about the inn explosion

4889.name: Torq Ironblast
4889.story: Torq Ironblast is a dwarf gunsmith who sells guns in Foothold Citadel on Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh. In Warcraft III: Reforged his name is the random enemy mountain king of the Gilneas Brigade, whose base in the Stonetalon Mountains Grom Hellscream's Warsong clan attacks. In Where Wyverns Dare he is the hero of the Human Expedition guarding the entrance to Stonetalon Peak.

appearances.role: The randomly named enemy mountain king who commands the Gilneas Brigade, first defending a base against the Warsong clan and later the entrance to Stonetalon Peak (Warcraft III: Reforged only)

2708.name: Archmage Malin
2708.story: Archmage Malin stands outside the Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind's Mage Quarter, and Archmage Trelane was his first master. In World of Warcraft he sends agents to the Arathi Highlands to gather reagents and recover Trelane's belongings. In the novella Elegy, set during the War of the Thorns, he holds portals open at the Wizard's Sanctum for night elf refugees fleeing to Stormwind. King Anduin has him send word to Dalaran asking its mages to help speed up the evacuation.

appearances.role: Holds portals open for night elf refugees from Teldrassil

15362.name: Malfurion Stormrage
15362.story: Malfurion Stormrage is the first of the druids and the Keeper of the Grove. In World of Warcraft he appears as an apparition, once in Moonglade and once in the Temple of Atal'Hakkar during the Scepter of the Shifting Sands quest chain. In the Temple of Atal'Hakkar he confirms that an Old God is corrupting the Emerald Dream. In Warcraft III he is called Furion Stormrage in Eternity's End, and Tyrande wakes him to fight the Burning Legion. In the novel Stormrage he is held captive in the Emerald Dream by the Nightmare Lord until he is freed, and he later marries Tyrande.

appearances.role: Keeper of the Grove hero, called Furion in these missions, who is woken by Tyrande and rouses the druids against the Burning Legion
Cutscenes only, as Furion: he and Tyrande confront the transformed Illidan in Felwood and meet Medivh on Mount Hyjal; in the final cinematic he unleashes Nordrassil's power to destroy Archimonde
Archdruid hero who joins Tyrande and Maiev against Illidan and his naga
Speaking character in the cutscenes: he learns of Illidan's naga from Maiev's messenger, sees the Eye of Sargeras plan in a vision and lets Illidan go
Held captive in the Emerald Dream by the Nightmare Lord until Thura frees him, then heals Teldrassil and marries Tyrande

15378.name: Merithra of the Dream
15378.story: In World of Warcraft, Merithra waits in the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj, where adventurers bring her Imperial Qiraji Regalia and Elementium Ore. In the short story The War of the Shifting Sands, Anachronos calls her, the child of Ysera, to join the fight against the qiraji. She and the other dragon progeny fly into the city to hold the qiraji back while the magical barrier is raised.

appearances.campaign: The War of the Shifting Sands
appearances.role: Charges into Ahn'Qiraj with Caelestrasz and Arygos to hold the qiraji back while the barrier is raised, and is overwhelmed

15380.name: Arygos
15380.story: In World of Warcraft, Arygos, in the form of a gnome, offers the quest Imperial Qiraji Armaments in the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj. In the short story The War of the Shifting Sands, he is one of the dragon progeny who fly into Ahn'Qiraj to hold the qiraji back. In Thrall: Twilight of the Aspects, he orders his guards to kill Thrall when Thrall comes to the Nexus, until Kalecgos intervenes.

appearances.campaign: The War of the Shifting Sands
appearances.role: Charges into Ahn'Qiraj with Merithra and Caelestrasz to hold the qiraji back while the barrier is raised
Orders his guards to kill Thrall when he arrives at the Nexus, until Kalecgos intervenes

5159.name: Daryl Riknussun
5159.story: Daryl Riknussun is a dwarf cooking trainer in Ironforge. In The War Effort, he helps Saegan clean and cook fish supplies for the Ahn'Qiraj War. The supplies are to be delivered to Huntress Swiftriver.

appearances.role: Helps Saegan clean and cook fish supplies for the Ahn'Qiraj War

6946.name: Renzik "The Shiv"
6946.story: Renzik is a goblin from Undermine who became the right hand of Trade Prince Mozzy Gloxscorn in the Krackslagger Cartel. In the short story The Tipping Point he fights Mathias Shaw and lets him go. He later left Undermine behind for Stormwind, and in the novella Elegy he is SI:7's spy in Orgrimmar. In World of Warcraft he works for SI:7 in the Old Town of Stormwind City.

appearances.role: Enforcer of Trade Prince Mozzy Gloxscorn in Undermine, who fights Mathias Shaw and lets him go
SI:7's chief spy in Orgrimmar, watching the Horde disguised as a merchant near Grommash Hold

3355.name: Saru Steelfury
3355.story: In the novella A Good War, a few weeks before the War of the Thorns an explosion rocked the Burning Anvil in Orgrimmar, where Saru Steelfury worked. Saru came out unscathed and blamed an apprentice's overcooked felslate, while High Overlord Saurfang promised him in writing that the lost Azerite would be replaced. In World of Warcraft he is a Blacksmithing Trainer at the Burning Anvil in the Valley of Honor, Orgrimmar.

appearances.role: Smith at the Burning Anvil in Orgrimmar; keeps High Overlord Saurfang's letter promising replacement Azerite after an explosion

14888.name: Lethon
14888.story: Lethon is one of Ysera's wayward dragon lieutenants and was among the strongest servants of the Nightmare. In the novel Stormrage he attacks Ysera, Tyrande Whisperwind, Broll Bearmantle, Eranikus and Gnarl during the War Against the Nightmare. He tries to corrupt Eranikus alongside Emeriss, and is forced to retreat when Alexstrasza arrives. Later he ambushes Malfurion Stormrage and Eranikus as they try to free Ysera from the Eye. When Eranikus shifts them both into the unstable boundary between the Emerald Dream and Azeroth, the chaotic energies tear both dragons apart.

appearances.role: One of Ysera's wayward dragons and a strong servant of the Nightmare; attacks Ysera, Tyrande, Broll Bearmantle, Eranikus and Gnarl, and is torn apart when he is pulled into the boundary between the Emerald Dream and Azeroth

295.name: Innkeeper Farley
295.story: Innkeeper Fredrik Farley runs the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, Elwynn Forest. In Before the Storm his brother Frandis, a caravan guard, traveled to Lordaeron, where he died of plague. Fredrik was devastated and was unaware until years later that Frandis had become Forsaken. After the Argus Campaign King Anduin Wrynn summoned him to Stormwind Keep.

appearances.role: Innkeeper Fredrik Farley; his brother Frandis, a caravan guard, dies of plague in Lordaeron, and Fredrik only learns years later that Frandis became Forsaken. Summoned to Stormwind Keep by King Anduin Wrynn after the Argus Campaign (chapter 23)

11832.name: Keeper Remulos
11832.story: Keeper Remulos is a keeper of the grove and one of the sons of Cenarius. A few years after the Third War, Moonglade was opened to all druid races and Keeper Remulos became its new guardian. In the novel Stormrage, Xavius uses Remulos as a pawn to lure Malfurion Stormrage into a trap, and Remulos is defeated and cleansed of his corruption. At the end of the novel he is one of many who witness the marriage of Tyrande and Malfurion. In the novel The Shattering: Prelude to Cataclysm, he refuses to let Hamuul Runetotem and Elerethe Renferal meet in Moonglade, but allows a second meeting there if the first goes well.

appearances.role: Turns on Malfurion after Xavius uses him as a pawn to lure Malfurion into a trap, until he is cleansed of his corruption
Refuses to let Hamuul Runetotem and Elerethe Renferal meet in Moonglade, but allows a second meeting there if the first goes well

10304.name: Aurora Skycaller
10304.story: Aurora Skycaller is a high elf priestess who helped Alliance adventurers recreate the Crystal of Zin-Malor at Northpass Tower. When the tower became a battlefield she moved to a spot just outside it, below Quel'Lithien Lodge, where she still gives quests in the Eastern Plaguelands. In the short story In the Shadow of the Sun she and Renthar Hawkspear reject the Regent Lord's offer of supplies.

appearances.campaign: In the Shadow of the Sun
appearances.role: Joins Renthar Hawkspear in turning down Lor'themar Theron's offer of supplies at Quel'Lithien Lodge

3230.name: Nazgrel
3230.story: Nazgrel was freed from an internment camp by Thrall and became one of his most trusted advisors. When Orgrimmar was built, he was put in charge of the new city's security. He could not leave the city when the harpy queen Bloodfeather attacked the caravans, so he sent Rexxar instead. He distrusts the Alliance. In World of Warcraft he stands in Grommash Hold as Thrall's general and chief of security.

appearances.campaign: The Founding of Durotar (Orc bonus campaign)
appearances.role: Quest giver (Raider): asks Rexxar to stop the harpies raiding the supply caravans
His men help carry the wounded orc Byrok to Thrall, and he readies the orc troops when the human army gathers at Northwatch Hold

11583.name: Nefarian
11583.story: Nefarian is the eldest son of Deathwing and a black dragon who can also take a human guise. In the novel Beyond the Dark Portal, Deathwing orders Nefarian and his sister Onyxia to secure the Blackrock orcs as their new force, and Nefarian takes command of Rend and Maim Blackhand. He allied the Dark Horde with the black dragonflight and experimented with the blood of every dragonflight to create the chromatic dragonflight. In World of Warcraft he rules from the top of Blackrock Spire and from Blackwing Lair, where he has enslaved the red dragon Vaelastrasz and commands him to kill the heroes of Azeroth.

appearances.role: Sent by Deathwing with his sister Onyxia to secure the Blackrock orcs as a new force; he arrives at Blackrock Spire and takes command of the Blackhand brothers

1747.name: Anduin Wrynn
1747.story: Anduin Llane Wrynn is the son of King Varian Wrynn and Queen Tiffin Ellerian Wrynn, named after Anduin Lothar and his grandfather King Llane Wrynn. He was thirteen during the Shattering, when he stayed in Ironforge. In Wolfheart he chose to study the Light with the prophet Velen, and in Blood of Our Fathers he healed his dying father Varian. In Stormrage he suffered nightmares from the Emerald Nightmare, and in Blood Ties he returned to Stormwind without reclaiming his throne. In World of Warcraft he is the young king of Stormwind, with Highlord Bolvar Fordragon acting as regent.

appearances.role: Thirteen-year-old prince staying in Ironforge as a Stormwind diplomat; witnesses King Magni Bronzebeard's petrification and persuades his father Varian to spare Moira Thaurissan (chapter 11)
Declines Varian's suggestion to study under Archbishop Benedictus and chooses to study the Light with the prophet Velen, leaving Stormwind to follow him
Heals the sick among the human refugees outside the Exodar after the Cataclysm and begs Velen to stop the riot between the refugees and the draenei guards
Reunited with Varian at Queen Tiffin's grave on Remembrance Day; shields his father from Twilight's Hammer assassins and heals him with the Light when a drakonid nearly kills him
Returns to Stormwind after the attack on Theramore Isle and cries out against Jaina's call to slaughter all orcs
As King of Stormwind, leads the Alliance's debate on Azerite and organizes the Gathering between the Forsaken and their living families in the Arathi Highlands
Returns to Stormwind after the fighting in Khaz Algar but does not reclaim his throne, leaving Turalyon in charge for now (chapter 2)
Suffers nightmares from the Emerald Nightmare in the weeks after the Lich King is killed (chapter 10)

14394.name: Major Mattingly
14394.story: Major Mattingly is a veteran of the Stormwind Army in the Valley of Heroes, serving under General Hammond Clay. When the Emerald Nightmare assaulted Stormwind, he went to Stormwind Keep to assemble reinforcements, but the valley was already enshrouded by the Nightmare. King Varian Wrynn then ordered him to escort Tyrande Whisperwind and others.

appearances.role: Stormwind Army veteran in the Valley of Heroes, serving under General Hammond Clay; during the Emerald Nightmare attack on Stormwind, King Varian Wrynn orders him to escort Tyrande Whisperwind and others (chapter 21)

1748.name: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon
1748.story: Bolvar Fordragon served as Highlord and Regent of Stormwind while King Varian Wrynn was missing. In World of Warcraft he rules Stormwind Keep as regent for the young Anduin Wrynn. In the later short story We Ride Forth, the Four Horsemen confront him in his role as the Lich King.

appearances.role: As the Lich King, he is confronted by the Four Horsemen over his increasingly militant actions

1749.name: Lady Katrana Prestor
1749.story: Lady Katrana Prestor is the black dragon Onyxia, daughter of Deathwing, in human form. In the novel Beyond the Dark Portal, Deathwing orders Onyxia and her brother Nefarian to secure the orcs of Blackrock Spire as their new force. As Lady Prestor she rose to be one of Stormwind's highest nobles and kept aid from reaching the lands near the Burning Steppes, where Nefarian held power. When King Varian vanished, she had the boy Anduin crowned and steered the regent Bolvar Fordragon with the Dragon's Eye. In the short story Visage Day she tells the bronze dragon Chronormu that a mortal form is only a tool for taking what a dragon wants. In World of Warcraft she is the royal councilor in Stormwind Keep and advises Bolvar against sending troops to Lakeshire.

appearances.role: As the dragon Onyxia, ordered by Deathwing to win over the Blackrock orcs

As the dragon Onyxia, receives the bronze dragon Chronormu in the Obsidian Dragonshrine, tells him a visage is only a tool for hunting mortals, and later attends his Visage Day ceremony at Wyrmrest Temple

2216.name: Apothecary Lydon
2216.story: In the short story Edge of Night, Lydon is a former young human alchemist who fought during Sylvanas' liberation. He has already embraced his fate and speaks of humans as another race, and Sylvanas answers that they will only serve in the battle. The story has him oversee the attack on Gilneas alongside Warchief Garrosh Hellscream, and he tries to persuade Garrosh not to use the Forsaken as a ramp of bodies. In World of Warcraft he is Apothecary Lydon, a quest giver in Tarren Mill who tests his poisons on his frog Umpi.

appearances.role: A former young human alchemist who serves Sylvanas and oversees the attack on Gilneas alongside Garrosh Hellscream

328.name: Zaldimar Wefhellt
328.story: Zaldimar Wefhellt is a human mage trainer located in the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, Elwynn Forest. During the War Against the Nightmare, the town of Goldshire had its minds trapped in the Emerald Nightmare. In Marshal Dughan's nightmare, Zaldimar accompanied Dughan on a mission in Jasperlode Mine and betrayed him after revealing he was a necromancer.

appearances.role: Accompanies Marshal Dughan on the Jasperlode Mine mission in Dughan's nightmare, and betrays him after revealing he is a necromancer

344.name: Magistrate Solomon
344.story: Magistrate Solomon is the judge of the Court of Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains. In the novel Traveler he declares Greydon Thorne dead two years after Greydon abandons his family, so Ceya Northbrooke can marry Robb Glade. In World of Warcraft he is a quest giver in Lakeshire.

appearances.role: The judge who declares Greydon Thorne dead two years after he leaves his family, so that Ceya Northbrooke can marry Robb Glade (chapter 12)

4421.name: Charlga Razorflank
4421.story: Charlga Razorflank is the quilboar shaman who leads the Razorfen tribe from Razorfen Kraul. She is the public figurehead of the Death's Head tribe, although Amnennar the Coldbringer ultimately controls it. Under her rule the quilboar drove the tauren out of the southern Barrens. The novel Traveler: The Spiral Path says she shaped most of the thorn dome of Razorfen Downs and trained Chugara Razorflank to maintain it. The novel also states that Chugara later surrendered Razorfen to the Death's Head tribe.

appearances.role: Mentioned in the novel: she shaped most of the thorn dome of Razorfen Downs and trained Chugara Razorflank to maintain it

376.name: High Priestess Laurena
376.story: High Priestess Laurena is a priest trainer located behind the altar in the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind City. In Before the Storm she blessed King Anduin Wrynn at the Lion's Rest ceremony after the Argus Campaign. She later tended to the body of Anduin's servant Wyll Benton for his funeral.

appearances.role: Blesses King Anduin Wrynn at the Lion's Rest ceremony after the Argus Campaign; later asks him to return to Stormwind as his servant Wyll Benton is dying, and tends to Wyll's body for the funeral

253471.name: Mordent Evenshade
253471.story: Archmage Mordent Evenshade is the leader of the Shen'dralar Highborne, the night elf mages who once served Prince Tortheldrin in Eldre'Thalas, the city adventurers know as Dire Maul. In WoW Forever you find him at Evenshade's Overlook in Shen'dralas, north of Dire Maul, where he stares toward a mass grave of his kin and mourns the destruction that ended his city. He is proud of his people's history and dislikes that outsiders reduce the city to a name like Dire Maul. In the novel Wolfheart, he tries to make amends and aid the kaldorei, but his Highborne mages are murdered in Darnassus. Maiev, who is behind the murders, lures him and his followers into a trap and kills his student Var'dyn Skyseeker, and Malfurion Stormrage and Jarod Shadowsong free the rest.

appearances.role: Leads the Highborne mages of Darnassus, who are murdered one by one, until Maiev's trap catches him and his followers and Malfurion and Jarod Shadowsong free them

11878.name: Nathanos Blightcaller
11878.story: Nathanos Blightcaller was the first and only human ranger lord trained by the high elves of Quel'Thalas, and he joined Sylvanas's rogue Forsaken after dying in the Third War. In World of Warcraft he returns to the Marris Stead in the Eastern Plaguelands with his blighthounds, recruiting Horde soldiers against plaguebats, the Scourge and the Scarlet Crusaders of Tyr's Hand. In the novel Before the Storm he serves as Sylvanas's champion and bodyguard and reports on the Undercity to her. In the novel Shadows Rising he is sent to kill the loa Bwonsamdi, and the attempt fails.

appearances.role: Accompanies Varok Saurfang on the trip to Felwood
Serves as Sylvanas's champion and bodyguard and reports on the Undercity to her
Sent by Sylvanas to kill the loa Bwonsamdi, fails, and returns to the Marris Stead to await orders
Agrees to a ritual Sylvanas calls him to, in which the Val'kyr sacrifice his cousin Stephon Marris to make him stronger
Saves Sylvanas and Lor'themar from an Amani ambush, is inducted into the Farstriders at her command, and after Garrosh's trial promises to stand by her side (chapter 23)

7999.name: Tyrande Whisperwind
7999.story: After the Battle of Mount Hyjal, Tyrande and Malfurion stayed on Hyjal to rebuild and later took their people back to Ashenvale to heal the damage done by the Burning Legion. Malfurion and Tyrande helped their people rebuild their shattered villages and ruled them for a time. Afterwards Malfurion's spirit was lost in the Emerald Dream, and Fandral Staghelm became Arch-Druid and planted Teldrassil. With Malfurion gone, Tyrande became the sole leader of the night elves, priestesses and Sentinels, and she often quarrelled with Fandral. In World of Warcraft she is High Priestess of Elune in Darnassus.

appearances.role: Playable hero (Priestess of the Moon)
Cutscenes only: the closing scene with Furion, and a speaking part in the interlude
Playable hero (Priestess of the Moon)
Speaking character in the cutscenes
Mentioned only: Maiev says she saw her "torn apart"
Rescue target: the swept-away priestess whom Illidan and Malfurion save
In the novel, set about 10,000 years before the First War, she is Sister Tyrande, a novice priestess in Suramar who is kind to the captive orc Broxigar and later frees him with Krasus and Rhonin
In the novel, set about 10,000 years before the First War, she appears as High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind
In the novel, set about 10,000 years before the First War, High Priestess Tyrande is abducted by Xavius and held in Queen Azshara's palace, where she refuses to join the queen's handmaidens
She learns through nightmares that Malfurion is dying, asks Broll Bearmantle to search the Emerald Dream and goes with him
Leads Alliance reinforcements into the battle for Ashenvale, blinds the invading Horde with Elune's light and is struck down by orc archers
Accuser at Garrosh Hellscream's trial in the Temple of the White Tiger, opposite the defender Baine Bloodhoof

15460.name: Grunt Maug
15460.story: Grunt Maug is an orc quest giver in the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar. During the Ahn'Qiraj war effort he collects tin bars for the Horde, asking for 22,000 so that weapons and armor can be made for the coming war. In Warcraft III: Reforged he is one of the grunts guarding the front gate of Orgrimmar in To Tame a Land.

appearances.role: One of the grunts guarding the front gate of Orgrimmar, named Maug (Warcraft III: Reforged only)

5709.name: Shade of Eranikus
5709.story: Eranikus, former consort of Ysera the Dreamer, was sent to guard the ruins of Atal'Hakkar and prevent Hakkar's emergence. Once inside the temple he and his retinue were corrupted, and he became a shade pulled between the Emerald Dream and the physical world. In the novel Stormrage he is despondent about the growing corruption and reluctant to help, but he later carries Tyrande and Broll to Bough Shadow, and he sacrifices himself so that Ysera can escape. In World of Warcraft the Shade of Eranikus is an elite boss in the Temple of Atal'Hakkar, and you must defeat Jammal'an the Prophet before you can fight him.

appearances.role: Refuses at first to help for fear of being corrupted again, then carries Tyrande and Broll to Bough Shadow and later sacrifices himself so Ysera can escape

6730.name: Jinky Twizzlefixxit
6730.story: Jinky is a neutral vendor at the Mirage Raceway in Thousand Needles. In the novel Traveler: The Spiral Path she took part in the Annual Speedbarge Boat Race as part of the Mechanical Engineers' Guild of Azeroth (MEGA) team with Tony Two-Tusk and Rugfizzle. She acted as the engineer of the Freebooters' Fire.

appearances.role: Engineer of the Freebooters' Fire in the Annual Speedbarge Boat Race, with teammates Tony Two-Tusk and Rugfizzle

1436.name: Watcher Cutford
1436.story: Watcher Cutford patrols the main road from Darkshire to the Twilight Grove. In Terror by Torchlight, in the aftermath of the Fourth War, he is still alive and a member of the Night Watch. In the short story he helped Mathias Shaw and Flynn Fairwind carry the wounded Commander Ladimore back to the Night Watch office in Darkshire.

appearances.role: Night Watch member: watches over the ailing Commander Ladimore while Shaw and Fairwind retrieve the torch and defeat the necromancer

2227.name: Sharlindra
2227.story: Sharlindra is one of the banshees in Sylvanas' forces when Sylvanas breaks free of Arthas and turns on the dreadlords. She went with Sylvanas' forces to attack the stronghold of the dreadlord Detheroc. In World of Warcraft she stands in the Royal Quarter of the Undercity, where her lieutenant Melisara sends adventurers after the Crown of Will.

appearances.role: Playable banshee unit in Sylvanas' forces (Warcraft III: Reforged only)
Witnesses Sylvanas refuse Varimathras' invitation to join his new order and wonders whether it would have been prudent to accept (chapter 14)
The first of Sylvanas' trusted counsel to fall in Sylvanas' Emerald Nightmare dream (chapter 18)

4949.name: Thrall
4949.story: After the Third War, Thrall gathered the orcs and found them a new home in Kalimdor. He founded Durotar, named after his father Durotan, with Orgrimmar as its capital, named after Orgrim Doomhammer. In The Founding of Durotar, Rexxar helped him secure the young nation. In World of Warcraft he leads the Horde as Warchief from his hall in the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar.

appearances.role: Cinematic: wakes from a dream in which the Prophet tells him to lead the Horde west
Playable hero (Far Seer); absent from chapters 4–5, which belong to Grom Hellscream; in the closing cinematic he faces Mannoroth with Grom
Allied commander (Far Seer): arrives with Jaina in The Last Guardian to hear the Prophet's warning, then fortifies the Horde base on Mount Hyjal against Archimonde's army in Twilight of the Gods

appearances.campaign: The Founding of Durotar (Orc bonus campaign)
appearances.role: Allied NPC; the Warchief who gives Rexxar his orders and commands the Horde against Admiral Proudmoore
Protagonist: Go'el's life in the internment camps, his escape from Durnholde Keep, and his rise to Warchief
Tries to keep the peace with Theramore while his chief warrior Burx attacks Northwatch Hold
Leads an attack on Stratholme that saves Eitrigg from execution and lets him join the New Horde (chapter 7)
Appoints Garrosh Hellscream acting warchief and travels to Nagrand to speak with the Furies
Leader of the Earthen Ring; meets Jaina in secret and refuses to return to the Horde to rein in Garrosh
Protagonist: sent by Ysera through the Caverns of Time into an alternate timeline, where he relives the murder of his parents
Suggests Baine Bloodhoof as Garrosh's defender and is called as Tyrande's witness at Garrosh's trial

2993.name: Baine Bloodhoof
2993.story: After the Third War, Baine went with his father Cairne as the tauren settled in Mulgore. Centaur led by Khiragg attacked the tauren village and kidnapped him, which sent Cairne into a lethargy. Rexxar found the centaur camp with the help of Bovan Windtotem, killed Khiragg and brought Baine back to his father. Afterward Baine served his father as an adviser. In World of Warcraft he leads the tauren at Bloodhoof Village, investigating the Venture Company and campaigning against the Palemane gnolls.

appearances.campaign: The Founding of Durotar (Orc bonus campaign)
appearances.role: Captive NPC (Cairne's son): kidnapped by centaur in Mulgore and rescued by Rexxar in the quest "Rescue Cairne's Son"
Guides the tauren in their resistance to the Nightmare and is forced to kill his friend Gam, whose vision the Nightmare twisted so that Baine looked like a centaur
Main character: leads the tauren in Cairne's place during his father's absences, and after Cairne's death leads the assault that retakes Thunder Bluff from the Grimtotem tribe
Main character: as high chieftain he agrees to send Mulgore's water to Orgrimmar, and with Hamuul he investigates the quilboar raids on the caravans
Co-leads the tauren and Darkspear army at Northwatch, confronts Garrosh over the molten giants and the Theramore attack, and has Perith Stormhoof warn Jaina Proudmoore of the attack
Chosen by Vol'jin as Garrosh Hellscream's defender at his trial in the Temple of the White Tiger, opposite Tyrande Whisperwind
Sylvanas Windrunner tasks him with organizing the Horde's healing efforts and orders him to cut off contact with King Anduin Wrynn
Questions Varok Saurfang about the Horde's march through the Barrens; Saurfang realizes Baine knows something of the real plan to invade Ashenvale

15990.name: Kel'Thuzad
15990.story: Kel'Thuzad was once a member of the Council of Six of the Kirin Tor in Dalaran. Antonidas threatened him with exile over his necromancy, so he left for Northrend, answered the Lich King's call and founded the Cult of the Damned in Lordaeron. In The Cult of the Damned Arthas and Jaina hunt him down in Andorhal, and later he is reborn as a lich. After the Third War he ruled the Eastern Plaguelands from the flying necropolis Naxxramas. In World of Warcraft he waits for adventurers in his chamber at the heart of Naxxramas, guarded by the Four Horsemen and the frost wyrm Sapphiron.

appearances.role: Necromancer behind the plague who flees from the cultists' camp in Ravages of the Plague, then admits to Arthas and Jaina in Andorhal that his cult spread the plagued grain, points them to Mal'Ganis in Stratholme and is hunted down and killed

Ghost advising Arthas while his remains are carried to the Sunwell, reborn as a lich in The Fall of Silvermoon, then guides the Scourge army, opens the Demon Gate, takes the Book of Medivh in Dalaran and summons Archimonde
Arthas's majordomo in Lordaeron: warns of the fleeing humans, helps him escape the assassins and drives off Sylvanas's banshees before Arthas sails for Northrend
Commands the Scourge assault on the Undercity from Naxxramas; Garek, Anya and Leonid defeat him and Baron Rivendare and he teleports away (Warcraft III: Reforged only)
Protagonist: Antonidas threatens to strip him of his rank over his necromancy, and he leaves Dalaran for Northrend to offer his service to the Lich King
Antonidas introduces him to Jaina Proudmoore as one of the finest mages in the Kirin Tor (chapter 8)

13442.name: Arch Druid Renferal
13442.story: Elerethe Renferal is a night elf archdruid of the Cenarion Circle and a close friend of Malfurion Stormrage. She was sent from Darnassus with Druids of the Grove to help the Stormpike Guard in their war with the Frostwolf clan. From the Dun Baldar North Bunker she asks Alliance adventurers for storm crystals to summon Ivus the Forest Lord, an Ancient of War who will judge the Horde's destruction of the valley. She deeply loves the lands of Alterac and wants to save its plants and animals. In the novel The Shattering: Prelude to Cataclysm she meets Hamuul Runetotem in Ashenvale just before the Cataclysm, and the meeting is broken up by an attack.

appearances.role: Attends the Cenarion Circle convocation Fandral Staghelm calls in Teldrassil, where Broll Bearmantle sees her speaking with Naralex (chapter 2)
Meets Hamuul Runetotem in southern Ashenvale to mend relations after an attack on the Sentinels, criticizes Thrall's choice of Garrosh but agrees to work toward peace

11406.name: High Priest Rohan
11406.story: In The Shattering: Prelude to Cataclysm, Rohan meets Anduin Wrynn in the Hall of Mysteries and heals him after he bumps into the gnome mages Dink and Bink. Shortly before the Cataclysm he witnesses Magni's petrification in Old Ironforge and casts healing spells to save the king, but it is too late. After the earthquakes he travels to Kharanos to heal the injured. When Moira Thaurissan claims the throne of Ironforge, he accepts her as the new queen, and when Anduin stops his father from killing her, he declares that she remains the future queen.

appearances.role: High priest of Ironforge and priest trainer in the Hall of Mysteries; heals Anduin Wrynn, witnesses Magni's petrification, and backs Moira Thaurissan as heir (chapters 11, 14, 15 and 31)

2487.name: Fleet Master Seahorn
2487.story: Fleet Master Seahorn is a tauren pirate of the Blackwater Raiders, located on the top floor of the Salty Sailor Tavern in Booty Bay. He is Baron Revilgaz's most trusted advisor. In the book Traveler: The Spiral Path he gives the ship Sea King to the new captain Adashe Flintwill. In the short story Stranglethorn Fishing Extravaganza, he warns Baron Revilgaz that a goblin is rowing into the harbor shouting his name.

appearances.role: Gives the ship Sea King to the new captain Adashe Flintwill (chapter 32)
Warns Baron Revilgaz that a goblin is rowing into the harbor shouting his name, which brings Riggle Bassbait to the Baron

4706.name: Razzeric
4706.story: Razzeric is an independent goblin pilot at the Mirage Raceway in the Shimmering Flats in Thousand Needles. In the novel Traveler: The Spiral Path, he registers for the Annual Fizzle and Pozzik's Speedbarge Boat Race as sponsor, engineer and pilot of his speedboat, the Guzzler. He finishes second in the race. Afterwards he leads a protest with Fizzle Brassbolts, claiming that Steamwhistle should be disqualified for switching pilots.

appearances.role: Sponsor, engineer and pilot of the speedboat Guzzler: second place in the Annual Fizzle and Pozzik's Speedbarge Boat Race, then led the protest against the result with Fizzle Brassbolts

4454.name: Fizzle Brassbolts
4454.story: Fizzle Brassbolts is a gnome and an avid member of the Mechanical Engineers' Guild of Azeroth (MEGA). He and the goblin Pozzik built the Mirage Raceway in Thousand Needles to prove the superiority of their respective races, and built rocket cars together. In the novel Traveler: The Spiral Path he led a protest with Razzeric after the Annual Speedbarge Boat Race.

appearances.role: Avid MEGA member who led the protest with Razzeric after the Annual Speedbarge Boat Race

4965.name: Pained
4965.story: In the novel Jaina Proudmoore: Tides of War, Pained is the night elf bodyguard whom Tyrande assigned to Jaina at the Battle of Mount Hyjal. She stayed with Jaina afterwards because she had never officially been relieved of her duty. In World of Warcraft she is Jaina Proudmoore's night elf bodyguard on Theramore Isle. The novel is set many years later and ends with her death when Theramore is destroyed.

appearances.role: Jaina's night elf bodyguard, who dies when Theramore is destroyed

4967.name: Archmage Tervosh
4967.story: Archmage Tervosh is a human quest giver in the Theramore Isle tower in Dustwallow Marsh and a close friend and advisor to Jaina Proudmoore. In Warcraft III: Reforged his name is one of the random enemy archmage heroes in the human bases that Grom Hellscream's Warsong clan attacks in the Stonetalon Mountains. In the game he sends adventurers after Private Hendel in The Missing Diplomat and gives out Shadowshard Fragments. In the novel Jaina Proudmoore: Tides of War he stays out of the Kirin Tor, helps Jaina and Kalecgos look for the stolen Focusing Iris, and is killed when the Horde destroys Theramore with a mana bomb. In the novel Wolfheart he goes to Darnassus on Jaina's behalf and votes to let Gilneas back into the Alliance.

appearances.role: One of the randomly named enemy archmage heroes defending the human bases in the Stonetalon Mountains against Grom Hellscream's Warsong clan (Warcraft III: Reforged only)
Advises his friend Jaina in Theramore, helps search for the stolen Focusing Iris, and dies in the mana bomb attack on the city
Travels to Darnassus for Jaina and votes to readmit Gilneas to the Alliance

4968.name: Lady Jaina Proudmoore
4968.story: After the Battle of Mount Hyjal, Jaina's expedition settled on the coast of Dustwallow Marsh and built the island citadel of Theramore to safeguard the ragtag remnants of the failing Alliance. She and Thrall declared that they would respect each other's territory. When her father Daelin Proudmoore threatened the Horde, she helped the Horde gain ships from the goblins and ordered her own troops to stand down when they assaulted Theramore. Daelin died in the fight, and the people of Kul Tiras nursed a bitter hatred towards Jaina for betraying her family. In World of Warcraft she rules Theramore from her tower.

appearances.role: Hero (sorceress) at Arthas's side: joins him in Jaina's Meeting, urges him to spare her people in Ravages of the Plague, follows him after the Prophet's warning, leaves him in The Culling and tells Uther in Divergent Courses that he has sailed for Northrend
Leader of the human survivors: opposes Thrall at Stonetalon Peak, then allies with him and gives him the soul gem

Allied commander (NPC) at the Battle of Mount Hyjal; arrives with Thrall in The Last Guardian to hear the Prophet's warning, then teleports in and helps Thrall delay Archimonde in Twilight of the Gods

appearances.campaign: The Founding of Durotar (Orc bonus campaign)
appearances.role: Allied NPC: helps Rexxar discover who is behind the human incursions, then tells Thrall about the goblin shipyard

5734.name: Apothecary Keever
5734.story: While the Forsaken kingdom was being founded, Grand Apothecary Putress had Garek Bandarion and Dark Ranger Anya bring corpses to Keever. They delivered the body of Othmar Garithos, which Keever turned into an abomination. In World of Warcraft he works in the Apothecarium of the Undercity, experimenting on caged prisoners under Master Apothecary Faranell.

appearances.role: Quest NPC: needs parts to assemble a new abomination (optional quest "From Many, One")

appearances.campaign: Arthas: Rise of the Lich King
appearances.role: Assisted Faranell in showing the effects of the Forsaken Blight to Sylvanas shortly before the War against the Lich King

14753.name: Illiyana Moonblaze
14753.story: Illiyana Moonblaze is a night elf tracker and PvP vendor in Silverwing Grove in Ashenvale. In the novel Wolfheart, set in the aftermath of the Cataclysm, she is one of Su'ura Swiftarrow's scouts when the Horde pushes into Ashenvale. She is the only scout to make it back to Silverwing Outpost alive, and she saves Su'ura when Garrosh Hellscream finds her injured. With her saber distracting Garrosh, she rescues Su'ura and retreats with the surviving Silverwing Sentinels to safer territory. After the battle for Ashenvale she is offered a commission, but she turns it down because it would mean more responsibility and less independence.

appearances.role: Silverwing Sentinel scout under Su'ura Swiftarrow who survives the Horde invasion of Ashenvale, saves Su'ura from Garrosh Hellscream, and turns down a commission afterwards

7267.name: Chief Ukorz Sandscalp
7267.story: Chief Ukorz Sandscalp is the leader of the Sandfury tribe and the ruler of Zul'Farrak, and he is accompanied by his right hand Ruuzlu. He is obsessed with restoring his tribe to its former glory. In the novel Traveler: The Spiral Path, Aramar Thorne and his group of friends are captured in Zul'Farrak and set to be sacrificed to the loa. In World of Warcraft he is the end boss of Zul'Farrak, and you can reach him by talking to Weegli Blastfuse or by starting the optional fight with Sergeant Bly.

appearances.role: Joins the sand trolls in summoning the loa Kimbul, Shadra and Mueh'zala with the blood of his prisoners (chapters 33-34)

3387.name: Jorn Skyseer
3387.story: Jorn Skyseer is a tauren hunter at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens. There he serves as a guide and mentor to Horde adventurers as they train in the wilds of the Barrens. In the novel The Shattering: Prelude to Cataclysm, he gives shelter and help to Baine Bloodhoof and his loyal forces when Magatha Grimtotem seizes Thunder Bluff.

appearances.role: Gives shelter to Baine Bloodhoof and his loyal forces in Thunder Bluff after Magatha Grimtotem takes control of the city (chapter 22)

4720.name: Rizzle Brassbolts
4720.story: Rizzle Brassbolts and his brothers were at the Mirage Raceway, working for the gnomish crew against the goblins there. His brothers are Fizzle and Wizzle Brassbolts. In the novel Traveler: The Spiral Path he was the pilot of the Annihilator in the Annual Speedbarge Boat Race.

appearances.role: Pilot of the Annihilator in the Annual Fizzle and Pozzik's Speedbarge Boat Race (chapter 28)

3516.name: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm
3516.story: After the Third War the night elves lost Nordrassil and their immortality, and Malfurion fell into a deep coma. His absence left the leadership of the druids to Fandral Staghelm, who became the new archdruid. Fandral convinced the other druids to create a new World Tree, and together they planted Teldrassil off the coast of northern Kalimdor. The tree was not blessed by the Dragon Aspects and the night elves did not regain their immortality, while corruption began to spread through Teldrassil. In World of Warcraft he leads the Cenarion Circle from the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus. In the short story The War of the Shifting Sands, he leads the night elves against the qiraji in Silithus, sees his son Valstann killed by the Qiraji general, and then helps the dragons seal Ahn'Qiraj behind a magical barrier.

appearances.role: Calls a convocation of druids on Teldrassil and insists on healing the tree, and the Nightmare Lord has tricked him with a vision of his dead son Valstann

appearances.campaign: The War of the Shifting Sands
appearances.role: Leads the night elf armies against the qiraji in Silithus, cannot reach his son Valstann before the Qiraji general kills him, and later helps the bronze dragon Anachronos seal the gates of Ahn'Qiraj

10181.name: Lady Sylvanas Windrunner
10181.story: When the Lich King's power waned, Sylvanas regained her free will and turned against Arthas. She took Lordaeron from the three dreadlords and gathered the freed undead as the Forsaken. Beneath the ruins of the capital, the Forsaken built the Undercity. With tauren leaders as mediators, the Forsaken joined the Horde. In World of Warcraft she holds court as the Banshee Queen in the Royal Quarter.

appearances.role: Enemy hero (Ranger) defending Quel'Thalas; turned into a banshee
Playable hero (Dark Ranger)
Banshee in the story interludes: meets the dreadlords in secret, then ambushes Arthas with a poisoned arrow
Leader of the Forsaken; gives the player orders

appearances.campaign: Arthas: Rise of the Lich King
appearances.role: Ranger-General of Silvermoon: fights Arthas' Scourge at the elfgates of Quel'Thalas and falls back with her surviving rangers to the second gate
Tormented by the Lich King and betrayed by Varimathras in her Emerald Nightmare dream
Attends Garrosh Hellscream's Horde leader meeting, opposes his plan to attack Theramore, and gets no support from Lor'themar Theron
Warchief of the Horde and queen of the Forsaken, whose trust Anduin must win while she pursues her own schemes
Leads a Horde army into Darkshore and later duels Malfurion after the two Horde armies rejoin

appearances.campaign: In the Shadow of the Sun
appearances.role: Travels to Sunfury Spire to gain the blood elves' support for the war effort
Protagonist: her story from Ranger-General of Silvermoon through her death at Arthas' hands to the founding of the Forsaken
Offers to defend Garrosh but is told she would serve better as an accuser, opposes Baine Bloodhoof as defender, and quarrels with him over his defense

3391.name: Gazlowe
3391.story: Gazlowe was chief engineer when Orgrimmar was built, and dug tunnels under the city in search of water. When the city was finished, Thrall paid him for the work. He then founded the port town of Ratchet at the mouth of the Southfury River in the Barrens. In World of Warcraft he runs Ratchet, a neutral trading port in the Barrens.

appearances.campaign: The Founding of Durotar (Orc bonus campaign)
appearances.role: Quest giver (Engineer): sends Rexxar into the tunnels under Orgrimmar to seal off the kobold dens
Thrall hires him to rebuild Orgrimmar after rogue fire elementals devastated the city
On his "factfinding" tours he strong-arms Marin Noggenfogger into letting him inspect his mine, and the two agree to align their cartels
Sponsors the Speedbarge boat race, lets Aram pilot for him, and helps the travelers into Gadgetzan and out again aboard his zeppelin Cloudkicker

3520.name: Ol' Emma
3520.story: Emma Felstone, known as Ol' Emma, came from the Felstone Field farm in the Eastweald of Lordaeron. She was married to Jem, who died in the First War, and had three sons: Jem, Jack and Jake. In Before the Storm she attends the Gathering in the Arathi Highlands, and afterwards returns there to bury her sons. In World of Warcraft she lives in the Canal District and carries water in Stormwind City.

appearances.role: Emma Felstone, searching among the Forsaken at the Gathering in the Arathi Highlands for her sons; when Sylvanas's dark rangers fire on the Forsaken, Anduin Wrynn sends her to safety on his gryphon

1573.name: Gryth Thurden
1573.story: Gryth Thurden is a dwarf gryphon flight master at the Great Forge in Ironforge. In The Shattering, Moira Thaurissan claims the gryphons are sick and has them quarantined outside the city. Gryth has no choice but to obey, since one of his gryphons had already been injured by a Dark Iron. He explains all of this to Prince Anduin Wrynn, who realizes that Moira is isolating Ironforge.

appearances.role: Ironforge gryphon master who tells Anduin Wrynn about Moira's gryphon quarantine

3139.name: Gar'Thok
3139.story: Gar'Thok served as Nazgrel's lieutenant at an outlying outpost in the young land of Durotar. He told Rexxar about the quilboar problem, but the outpost was later attacked by sailors from Kul Tiras, who killed his men. He survived the attack and stayed in Razor Hill to instruct young members of the Horde in dealing with Durotar's problems. In World of Warcraft he is a quest giver in Razor Hill.

appearances.campaign: The Founding of Durotar (Orc bonus campaign)
appearances.role: Quest giver (Grunt, Nazgrel's lieutenant): sends Rexxar through the Beast Den to the observatory to survey the border; his outpost is later destroyed by the humans

332.name: Master Mathias Shaw
332.story: Mathias Shaw is the leader of Stormwind's intelligence service, SI:7, and a master of spies. In Before the Storm he reports SI:7's findings about Azerite to King Anduin Wrynn's advisers, and he remained neutral when Anduin proposed the Gathering. In the audio short story The Tipping Point he fights the goblin enforcer Renzik in Undermine and gives him a coin to show the master of cheese in Stormwind. In Terror by Torchlight he and Flynn Fairwind recover the Torch of Holy Flame from a necromancer in Duskwood. In World of Warcraft he heads SI:7 from its barracks in Old Town.

appearances.role: Handpicks Owynn Graddock to accompany Varian and other SI:7 assassins through the Deeprun Tram into Ironforge to liberate it (chapter 30)
Worries when King Varian is missing before his Remembrance Day speech and joins Marcus Jonathan and Jaina Proudmoore in searching for the king and the prince
Protects his goblin informants in Undermine, fights Renzik and is let go by him, and gives him a coin to show to Elling Trias, the master of cheese in Stormwind
Leader of SI:7; briefs King Anduin Wrynn's advisers on the Azerite information SI:7 gathered, and remains neutral when Anduin proposes the Gathering
Oversees the SI:7 operation that saturates Orgrimmar with agents and reports the quarrel between Nathanos Blightcaller and Varok Saurfang to Anduin and Genn Greymane
Travels to Zandalar with Flynn Fairwind to gather intelligence, is captured by the Zandalari, and later brings the prisoner Sira Moonwarden to Stormwind
With Flynn Fairwind, tracks down the necromancer who stole the Torch of Holy Flame in Duskwood and retrieves the torch

7800.name: Mekgineer Thermaplugg
7800.story: In his youth, Sicco Thermaplugg was the closest friend of Gelbin Mekkatorque, and Gelbin later employed him at his foundry. Sicco resented Gelbin for being elected High Tinker of Gnomeregan and believed the gnomes should use their inventions to expand their power instead of trading them to allies. Gelbin kept Sicco in a prominent role in the Tinkers' Court despite his flawed work, and Sicco went on to serve as Gelbin's chief advisor for many years. In the short story Cut Short he sets a trap for Gelbin in his old quarters in Sector 17 and attacks him in a battle suit, but Gelbin's trap cuts him in half, his battle suit saves his life, and Gelbin leaves him for dead. In World of Warcraft he is a boss in Gnomeregan.

appearances.role: Self-styled king of Gnomeregan who traps Gelbin Mekkatorque in his old quarters and attacks him in a battle suit until Gelbin's trap cuts Thermaplugg in half

253957.name: Muln Earthfury
253957.story: Muln Earthfury is a tauren shaman and a leader of the Earthen Ring, the shaman who work to keep the elements in balance. In WoW Forever he is at Camp Gev'rek on Skywatcher Plateau in northwestern Mulgore, where the Earthen Ring and the skyborne Windshapers have joined forces. The Windshapers' leader Ayessa Dawnsinger contacted him because their home island in Skywall, the plane of air, was collapsing, and he led Earthen Ring forces there to help against Rohash. Skyborne players meet him again in the finale of their starting experience on Zephras Isle. In the novel Thrall: Twilight of the Aspects, he is worried about Thrall at the Maelstrom, and in Jaina Proudmoore: Tides of War he has handed the Earthen Ring to Thrall after Deathwing's fall.

appearances.role: Worries about Thrall at the Maelstrom while the former Warchief cannot focus on his shamanic duty, and is glad to see him calmer when he returns
Joins Nobundo and Aggra in rescuing Thrall while Deathwing torments him
Steps down as leader of the Earthen Ring in favor of Thrall, and urges the shaman to go help the enslaved water elementals

3144.name: Eitrigg
3144.story: Eitrigg was born into the Blackrock clan on Draenor. In the novel The Shattering: Prelude to Cataclysm he was in his late fifties by the time the Lich King was defeated. In the novel Of Blood and Honor, after meeting Thrall he found that his people had rediscovered their shamanistic roots, and he returned to life among his own kind. In the novel Jaina Proudmoore: Tides of War, he was against Garrosh's plan to conquer Kalimdor, and Baine Bloodhoof supported him. In World of Warcraft he serves the Horde as an advisor and supporter to Thrall, and can be found in Thrall's throne room in Orgrimmar.

appearances.role: Blackrock orc who meets Thrall and leaves with his people to return to their shamanistic roots
Opposes Garrosh Hellscream's plan to conquer Kalimdor at the Horde leaders' meeting, with Baine Bloodhoof's support
Accompanies Thrall to Dustwallow Marsh, becomes one of Garrosh's advisers and warns Garrosh that Magatha has staged a coup
Goes with Go'el and Varok to Garrosh's trial, where he declines to be Garrosh's defender and backs the choice of Baine instead
Advises Overlord Geya'rah to stand down during a clash with Stromgarde, and later joins the allied armies before Stromgarde Keep

4488.name: Parqual Fintallas
4488.story: Before the Plague, Parqual Fintallas was a human historian in Capital City, living with his wife Mina and daughter Philia. As an undead Forsaken he was unsure what had become of his family, and Philia's teddy bear Brownie was one of the few remnants of his old life. In Before the Storm he smuggled books from his former home into the Undercity with the help of Horde adventurers, and he joined the Desolate Council founded by his friend Vellcinda Benton. At the Gathering in the Arathi Highlands he was reunited with his daughter. He then tried to defect to the Alliance at Stromgarde Keep, and he was killed by Sylvanas' dark rangers as he ran toward Stromgarde. In World of Warcraft he works in the Apothecarium of the Undercity.

appearances.role: Forsaken former historian of Lordaeron, titled Governor in chapter 19 and a member of the Desolate Council; reunited with his daughter Philia at the Gathering and killed in chapter 34

7804.name: Trenton Lighthammer
7804.story: In World of Warcraft, Trenton Lighthammer is a night elf blacksmith of the Mithril Order near Gadgetzan's southern gate, where he trains armorsmiths and asks adventurers for troll temper from Zul'Farrak. In Traveler: The Spiral Path, he lets Aramar Thorne and his companions sleep in his tower. Aram and Trenton forge a new harpoon for Makasa, and Trenton gives Aram a new iron chain for his compass.

appearances.role: Lets Aramar Thorne and his companions sleep in his tower, and forges a harpoon with Aram for Makasa Flintwill

11753.name: Gogo
11753.story: Gogo is a goblin located in Everlook in Winterspring. In the novel Before the Storm, Kezzig Klackwhistle hangs around her while he is in a relationship with Lunnix Sprocketslip. When Lunnix caught them, her ire caused Kezzig to leave Everlook for Silithus.

appearances.role: Kezzig Klackwhistle hangs around her while he is in a relationship with Lunnix Sprocketslip

5769.name: Hamuul Runetotem
5769.story: Hamuul Runetotem is the archdruid of the tauren and the leader of the Horde druids. In the novel Stormrage, he became a close friend of Broll, who considers him his closest friend apart from Varian and Valeera. In The Shattering: Prelude to Cataclysm, he met Cairne Bloodhoof at Red Rocks to discuss how Garrosh had rebuilt Orgrimmar, and he was sending messages to the Cenarion Circle. In Tides of War, he stepped forward to aid Baine Bloodhoof when Baine and Garrosh Hellscream confronted each other over the planned attack on Theramore, until both were ordered to stand down.

appearances.role: Archdruid who becomes a close friend of Broll and is among the archdruids summoned to Teldrassil
Archdruid in Orgrimmar; sends messages to the Cenarion Circle and discusses Garrosh's rebuilt Orgrimmar with Cairne Bloodhoof at Red Rocks
Baine Bloodhoof asks him about the Quilboar attacks on the water caravans to Orgrimmar
Steps in to aid Baine Bloodhoof when Baine and Garrosh confront each other over the attack on Theramore, until both are ordered to stand down

1323.name: Osric Strang
1323.story: Osric Strang is a human heavy armor vendor located at Limited Immunity in Old Town, Stormwind. In Before the Storm he recalls arguing over armor-making with his friend Tomas Gray, who served as a guard in Lordaeron while Osric served in Stormwind. He attended the Gathering with a helm he had made for Tomas.

appearances.role: Attends the Gathering with a helm he made for his friend Tomas Gray, with whom he used to argue over who made the best armor when they served as guards; walks with Emma Felstone

8197.name: Chronalis
8197.story: In World of Warcraft, Chronalis is an elite bronze drake that guards the entrance to the Caverns of Time in eastern Tanaris, together with Tick. In Thrall: Twilight of the Aspects, he at first refuses Thrall and Desharin entry to the Caverns of Time. He lets them through only after learning they were acting under Ysera's direction.

appearances.role: Denies Thrall and Desharin entry to the Caverns of Time, then escorts them in once they are shown to be acting under Ysera's direction

2257.name: Mug'thol
2257.story: Mug'thol led a group of Stonemaul ogres that stayed in Lordaeron after the Second War. In The Dark Lady, Sylvanas Windrunner had her banshees possess him so that his ogres would fight Varimathras instead of waiting in the hills. Later he and his warband were sent to the ruins of Alterac to retrieve the Crown of Will for Sylvanas. Instead of handing it over he put it on, which freed him from the banshee's possession. He then settled in the ruins of Alterac as the warlord of the Crushridge ogres, and Horde adventurers were sent to take the crown back.

appearances.role: Optional unit (Ogre Warlord of the Stonemaul): Sylvanas' banshees can possess him and his ogres to fight Varimathras

3660.name: Athrikus Narassin
3660.story: In Warcraft III the item text of Athrikus' Ring of Power says Athrikus Narassin coveted the Well of Eternity and its arcane powers. When the Well exploded, his magical items were blasted from his body and scattered across Kalimdor. He survived, found himself imbued with demonic powers, and used them to chain the souls of lesser highborne to himself, granting him immortality. In World of Warcraft he leads the Cult of the Dark Strand from the Tower of Althalaxx in Darkshore, and Balthule Shadowstrike sends Alliance adventurers to kill him and bring back his head.

appearances.campaign: The Founding of Durotar (Orc bonus campaign)
appearances.role: Item lore only: the history text of the artifact Athrikus' Ring of Power tells his story; he does not appear as a unit

4501.name: Draz'Zilb
4501.story: Draz'Zilb was among the ogres present when Rexxar arrived at Stonemaul Village. Rexxar challenged the chieftain Kor'gall, who refused to aid the Horde, and Kor'gall died in the duel. In World of Warcraft he is an intelligent ogre mage in Brackenwall Village. He orchestrated the ousting of the corrupt Mok'Morokk from the Stonemaul clan with the aid of Horde adventurers.

appearances.campaign: The Founding of Durotar (Orc bonus campaign)
appearances.role: Stonemaul ogre present in the ogre village in Dustwallow Marsh (Warcraft III: Reforged only)

4502.name: Tharg
4502.story: Tharg was among the ogres present when Rexxar arrived at Stonemaul Village. Rexxar challenged the chieftain Kor'gall, who refused to aid the Horde, and Kor'gall died in the duel. In World of Warcraft Tharg is a survivor of the Onyxia brood's raid on Stonemaul Village, and his wife was among the ogres the black dragons slew. He refuses to consider Brackenwall Village their home and wants to reclaim Stonemaul Village.

appearances.campaign: The Founding of Durotar (Orc bonus campaign)
appearances.role: Stonemaul ogre present in the ogre village in Dustwallow Marsh (Warcraft III: Reforged only)

7564.name: Marin Noggenfogger
7564.story: In World of Warcraft, Marin Noggenfogger sends adventurers into the desert to collect Laden Dew Glands for his new elixir. He sends them to his friend Sprinkle, a Gadgetzan chef, who turns a Violet Tragan mushroom into a powder that makes the elixir palatable. In Traveler: The Spiral Path, he supervises the Thunderdrome bets, and Malus blackmails him into revealing the Crustacean booking. In the short story The Goblin Way, he agrees to align his cartel with Gazlowe's after Gazlowe demands an inspection of his mine.

appearances.role: Under Malus's blackmail, tips him off that Aramar Thorne booked passage on the Crustacean, which sends Malus out of Gadgetzan
Agrees to align his Steamwheedle Cartel with Gazlowe's after Gazlowe demands an inspection of his mine

10508.name: Ras Frostwhisper
10508.story: Ras Frostwhisper was a hedge mage from Stromgarde who joined the Cult of the Damned early and rose through its ranks. In Siege he led cultists out of Andorhal and fought Garek Bandarion before teleporting away to Stratholme. There he cut his own throat and was raised as a lich by the Lich King, then was attacked by Garek and Ilastar Songbreeze, though he swore he would meet them again. In World of Warcraft he is the favored pupil of Kel'Thuzad and oversees everything that happens in the necromancy school of Scholomance.

appearances.role: Enemy lich hero among the Scourge commanders in the assault on Hearthglen (Warcraft III: Reforged only)
Boss: leads cultists out of Andorhal against the Lordaeron bases and is cornered by Garek Bandarion and the Silver Hand before he teleports away to Stratholme
Boss: raised as a lich in the Stratholme slaughterhouse, then defeated by Garek Bandarion and Ilastar Songbreeze

4046.name: Magatha Grimtotem
4046.story: Magatha Grimtotem became matriarch of her tribe after her husband's accidental death. In the book, she offered the support of the Grimtotem tribe to the new Warchief Garrosh Hellscream as a way to dispose of Cairne Bloodhoof. When Cairne challenged Garrosh to mak'gora, she applied poison to the blade of Gorehowl, and Garrosh killed him. Her tribe then attacked Thunder Bluff and the other tauren towns to kill everyone in them, Cairne's son Baine included.

appearances.role: Antagonist: Grimtotem matriarch who poisons the blade of Garrosh's axe Gorehowl so that Garrosh can kill Cairne Bloodhoof; then orders her tribe to attack Thunder Bluff

7312.name: Dink
7312.story: Dink is a gnome mage trainer in the Hall of Mysteries in Ironforge, and the brother of the mage trainer Bink. In The Shattering: Prelude to Cataclysm, Dark Iron guards catch Dink and Bink when Moira Thaurissan arrives in Ironforge. They are released when Ironforge dwarves attack the guards.

appearances.role: Gnome mage, brother of Bink, who is caught by Dark Iron guards when Moira Thaurissan arrives in Ironforge and is released when Ironforge dwarves attack them

4047.name: Zor Lonetree
4047.story: In the novel Stormrage, when the Emerald Nightmare attacked Azeroth, Malfurion Stormrage contacted Zor to gather allies against the Nightmare Lord. In World of Warcraft he stands in Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar and is well schooled in Alliance politics. He sends adventurers to help the spirits of the Stonetalon Mountains.

appearances.role: Ally whom Malfurion Stormrage contacts for help against the Nightmare Lord when the Emerald Nightmare attacks Azeroth

2263.name: Marshal Redpath
2263.story: In the novel Tides of Darkness (Aaron Rosenberg's retelling of the Second War), Marcus Redpath is the headman of Southshore. He greets Anduin Lothar, Khadgar and the refugees from the Kingdom of Stormwind. He sends his fastest rider, Willem, to King Terenas Menethil II to announce their arrival. After the Third War he is Southshore's marshal, eager to rid the region of murlocs, Crushridge ogres and naga. In World of Warcraft he stands in Southshore as Marshal Redpath.

appearances.role: The headman of Southshore who greets Anduin Lothar and the Stormwind refugees in the first prologue

1646.name: Baros Alexston
1646.story: Baros Alexston grew up on the Alexston Farmstead in Westfall and worked with Edwin VanCleef in the Stonemasons' Guild to rebuild Stormwind after the First War. When the House of Nobles refused to pay the guild and VanCleef led the stonemasons out in rebellion, Baros took the post of city architect instead and made an enemy of his old friend. In World of Warcraft he works in Stormwind's City Hall in Cathedral Square. In the short story Blood of Our Fathers, set after Deathwing's attack on Stormwind, he oversees the rebuilding of the city and keeps King Varian informed of its progress and price.

appearances.role: The architect rebuilding Stormwind after Deathwing's attack

1200.name: Morbent Fel
1200.story: Morbent Fel was a human necromancer who ruled over the undead of Duskwood from his house atop the Forlorn Rowe in Raven Hill Cemetery. He was an ally of the Dark Riders and was responsible for raising the undead in Duskwood. In World of Warcraft he is guarded by his undead minions and a magical barrier, which had to be removed with Morbent's Bane before he could be defeated.

appearances.role: Remembered as the dead lich of the Forlorn Rowe; the stolen Torch of Holy Flame is placed outside his old house

3030.name: Siln Skychaser
3030.story: In World of Warcraft Siln Skychaser is a tauren shaman trainer on Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff. She belongs to the Skychaser tribe, the spiritual leaders of the tauren. In the novel The Shattering: Prelude to Cataclysm, set years later, she is killed by the Grimtotem tribe after Cairne Bloodhoof's death.

appearances.role: Mentioned: killed by the Grimtotem tribe after Cairne Bloodhoof's death

3031.name: Tigor Skychaser
3031.story: In World of Warcraft Tigor Skychaser is a tauren shaman trainer on Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff. He belongs to the Skychaser tribe, the spiritual leaders of the tauren. In the novel The Shattering: Prelude to Cataclysm, set years later, he is killed by the Grimtotem tribe after Cairne Bloodhoof's death.

appearances.role: Mentioned: killed by the Grimtotem tribe after Cairne Bloodhoof's death

3032.name: Beram Skychaser
3032.story: In World of Warcraft Beram Skychaser is a tauren shaman trainer on Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff. Years later, in the time of the novel The Shattering: Prelude to Cataclysm, he blesses Cairne Bloodhoof's runespear for the mak'gora duel against Garrosh Hellscream. After Cairne's death he is killed by the Grimtotem tribe.

appearances.role: Killed by the Grimtotem tribe after Cairne Bloodhoof's death

10540.name: Vol'jin
10540.story: Vol'jin stayed behind on the Darkspear isles when many trolls sailed to Kalimdor with the orcs. Rexxar, Rokhan and Chen Stormstout helped him evacuate the tribe, and he advised Rexxar to recruit the tauren and the ogres against the humans. After the war he led the tribe back to the Echo Isles, but the witch doctor Zalazane enslaved many of them with dark magic. Vol'jin withdrew to the mainland and founded Sen'jin Village on the southern coast of Durotar. In World of Warcraft he lives in Thrall's fortress in Orgrimmar and advises the Warchief.

appearances.campaign: The Founding of Durotar (Orc bonus campaign)
appearances.role: Quest giver and advisor (Witch Doctor); the Darkspear chieftain turns Rexxar, Rokhan and Chen into spirit wyverns
Protagonist: sent into First Home with his best friend Zalazane to be tested by the loa and become a shadow hunter
Leads the Darkspear at Northwatch Hold and in Garrosh's attack on Theramore, and questions the plan to drive out the night elves
Poisoned by Garrosh's assassins, recovers at the Shado-Pan Monastery with Chen Stormstout's help, and receives Shado-Pan monk training
As Warchief he offers Baine Bloodhoof the role of Garrosh's defender, vetoes the Alliance's choice of Varian as accuser, and later testifies as Tyrande's witness

7583.name: Sprinkle
7583.story: In World of Warcraft, Sprinkle is a Gadgetzan chef whose secret ingredient is the Violet Tragan mushroom from the Hinterlands. She has adventurers gather the mushroom, turns it into a powder, and hands it back to them with a message that Marin owes her a favor. In Traveler: The Spiral Path, she meets Gazlowe and Aramar Thorne on a staged picnic and hides the children in her caravan to bring them into Gadgetzan unseen. Later she tells her husband that the Crustacean is where the travelers have booked passage, and he passes this on to Malus.

appearances.role: Smuggles Aramar Thorne's companions into Gadgetzan hidden in her caravan during a staged picnic, and suggests Winifred's home as a safe house

14889.name: Emeriss
14889.story: Emeriss is a green dragon of Ysera's flight who was turned into a servant of the Nightmare. In the novel Stormrage she is one of the major antagonists of the War Against the Nightmare. She and Lethon attack Eranikus to corrupt him, but Alexstrasza forces the corrupted dragons to retreat. Later she attacks Tyrande Whisperwind and Malfurion Stormrage, and when Tyrande tries to remove her corruption with the power of Elune, Emeriss is disintegrated. Her tainted essence remains tied to the Nightmare and to Xavius.

appearances.role: Corrupted green dragon and servant of the Nightmare; one of the major antagonists of the War Against the Nightmare, who is disintegrated when Tyrande tries to cleanse her

11833.name: Rahauro
11833.story: Rahauro was the servant of Magatha Grimtotem in Thunder Bluff. In The Shattering: Prelude to Cataclysm, he loyally aided Magatha in securing Thunder Bluff for the Grimtotem tribe. He grew worried when Magatha told him that Garrosh Hellscream refused to aid the Grimtotem.

appearances.role: Servant of Magatha Grimtotem: helps her secure Thunder Bluff for the Grimtotem tribe

2784.name: King Magni Bronzebeard
2784.story: During the Second War Magni defended Ironforge from the orcs and joined the Alliance of Lordaeron. He was a founding member of the Explorers' League, led by his brother Brann. In The Shattering: Prelude to Cataclysm, Magni performed a ritual in Old Ironforge to commune with the earth and was turned into diamond.

appearances.role: Dwarf king who defends Ironforge during the Siege of Ironforge in the Second War and pledges the kingdom's support to the Alliance of Lordaeron after its liberation
King of Ironforge who performs a ritual from a tablet from Ulduar in Old Ironforge to commune with Azeroth and is turned into diamond

Former king and Herald of Azeroth who recruits Alliance and Horde leaders to help restore Azeroth after Sargeras's destruction, meeting Warchief Sylvanas Windrunner and Baine Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff
Attends the wedding of Turalyon and Alleria Windrunner with his family in chapter 17

3679.name: Naralex
3679.story: In World of Warcraft, Naralex tried to bring life back to the Barrens through the Wailing Caverns, but the Emerald Dream corrupted the caverns and trapped him in sleep until adventurers and his disciple Muyoh woke him. In the novel Stormrage, he was healed after the War Against the Nightmare and witnessed the wedding of Tyrande Whisperwind and Malfurion. At the start of the War Against the Nightmare he worked with other druids to heal Teldrassil, unknowingly corrupting it further. He discovered Fandral's corruption and told Hamuul Runetotem, and together they went to Darnassus to warn Shandris Feathermoon, but the trio was silenced by Fandral. Malfurion Stormrage later found them and set them free, though Naralex was more badly wounded than the others.

appearances.role: A druid who discovers Fandral Staghelm's corruption, is silenced with Hamuul Runetotem and Shandris Feathermoon, and is later freed by Malfurion

240.name: Marshal Dughan
240.story: Marshal Dughan is a human located in Goldshire and part of the Stormwind Army, in charge of security in Goldshire and the surrounding area. He is very concerned about the kobolds to the north and the gnolls and thieves to the west. In Stormrage the Emerald Nightmare traps the minds of Goldshire, and Dughan dreams of a mission against kobolds in Jasperlode Mine with Zaldimar Wefhellt, where he fails his men and himself.

appearances.role: Stormwind Army leader in Goldshire; during the Emerald Nightmare he dreams of a mission against kobolds in Jasperlode Mine with Zaldimar Wefhellt, where he fails his men and himself (chapter 4)

3936.name: Shandris Feathermoon
3936.story: Shandris Feathermoon is a night elf sentinel who serves the high priestess Tyrande Whisperwind. In the Third War she appears in the Warcraft III night elf campaign: she is with Tyrande when the orcs and humans enter Ashenvale, and she waits for Tyrande at an outpost when the undead attack. She also takes part in the defence of Mount Hyjal. By the time of World of Warcraft she is General of the Sentinel Army and commands Feathermoon Stronghold on Sardor Isle in Feralas, named after her. From there she sends Alliance adventurers to investigate the Hatecrest naga in the Ruins of Solarsal. In the novel Jaina Proudmoore: Tides of War she brings Sentinels to help defend Theramore, then leads them north into Dustwallow Marsh to look for the traitor Thalen Songweaver.

appearances.role: Night elf Sentinel unit (Ranger/Archer, not a hero) with Tyrande's forces; in Daughters of the Moon she waits at the outpost and warns that the undead attacked her village, and in Twilight of the Gods she is a playable unit at Mount Hyjal
Young girl who secretly follows Tyrande into battle and shoots the arrow that wounds Xavius, giving Malfurion the opening to confront him (chapters 9, 17, 18, 23)
Joins the Sisterhood of Elune under Jarod Shadowsong and drops demons with her arrows in the final battle against Archimonde (chapters 3, 20)
Left in charge of Darnassus while Tyrande follows Broll into the Emerald Dream, and gives Tyrande her hippogryph Jai'alator for the journey
Reunites with Jarod Shadowsong in Darnassus, then rallies an army with Tyrande to drive the Horde out of Ashenvale
Brings a force of Sentinels to defend Theramore, then leads them north into Dustwallow Marsh to find the traitor Thalen Songweaver

3173.name: Swart
3173.story: In the short story As Our Fathers Before Us, some time after the Cataclysm, Swart explained the reasons behind the quilboar aggression to Baine Bloodhoof. In World of Warcraft he is an orc shaman trainer. He trains shamans in the Razor Hill Barracks in Durotar.

appearances.role: Explains the reasons for quilboar aggression to Baine Bloodhoof

1852.name: Araj the Summoner
1852.story: Araj the Summoner is a lich and the ruler of the ruins of Andorhal in the Western Plaguelands. He is the former leader of Scholomance, and from Andorhal he spreads the Plague of Undeath through the plague cauldrons while holding off the Forsaken at the Bulwark and the Alliance at Chillwind Camp. In Warcraft III: Reforged he is the regional commander of the Scourge who leads the Undead Ravagers against Hearthglen in March of the Scourge. In the game adventurers kill him on the orders of Commander Ashlam Valorfist and High Executor Derrington, and his scarab is used to make the key to Scholomance.

appearances.role: Scourge lich who commands the Undead Ravagers in their attack on Hearthglen, replacing the randomly named lich hero of the original (Warcraft III: Reforged only)

8379.name: Archmage Xylem
8379.story: Archmage Xylem is a human quest giver who lives in his tower in the mountains of northern Azshara. Long ago the green drake Morphaz devoured one of his apprentices and the arcane shard the apprentice carried, and Xylem has sworn to hunt the drake down and recover it. In Warcraft III: Reforged his name is one of the random enemy archmage heroes in the human bases that Grom Hellscream's Warsong clan attacks in the Stonetalon Mountains. In Where Wyverns Dare he can also be the archmage of the Lordaeron Brigade.
