appearances.role: One of the randomly named enemy archmage heroes defending the human bases in the Stonetalon Mountains against Grom Hellscream's Warsong clan (Warcraft III: Reforged only)

1570.name: Executor Arren
1570.story: Executor Arren is a Forsaken who commands Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades. He is the first leader that newly risen Forsaken meet, and he sends them on their first tasks. He greets newcomers with the words "All of the Forsaken must do what they can for the good of their brothers and sisters." In Warcraft III: Reforged, Forsaken Kingdom, Bernd asks the player to survey the villages damaged by the Scarlet Crusade, and Arren is the Deathknell stop on that tour.

appearances.role: Sends the player to defeat the Essence of Fear for Deathknell during the Assess the Damage quest, then takes the report

15192.name: Anachronos
15192.story: In World of Warcraft, Anachronos is the heir of Nozdormu and guards the Caverns of Time in Tanaris. In the short story The War of the Shifting Sands, he calls the other dragonflights to fight the qiraji. In Thrall: Twilight of the Aspects, he is present when Nozdormu is brought back to the Caverns of Time after the Cataclysm.

appearances.campaign: The War of the Shifting Sands
appearances.role: Calls the bronze dragonflight and the other dragon flights to fight the qiraji, and summons the barrier at Ahn'Qiraj
Is present when Thrall returns Nozdormu to the Caverns of Time after the Cataclysm

1499.name: Magistrate Sevren
1499.story: Magistrate Sevren is a Forsaken quest giver in the Town Hall of Brill in Tirisfal Glades. He hands out the early duties of the newly freed Forsaken around Brill. In Warcraft III: Reforged, Forsaken Kingdom, Bernd sends the player to survey the damaged villages, and Brill and Sevren are the first stop.

appearances.role: Asks the player to deal with the goblins near Brill during the Assess the Damage quest, then takes the report

2285.name: Count Remington Ridgewell
2285.story: Count Remington Ridgewell is a member of the House of Nobles, located in the Petitioner's Chamber in Stormwind Keep. His family's house runs a museum that exhibits valuable objects and artworks. In Before the Storm he greets Fredrik Farley when King Anduin Wrynn summons him to Stormwind Keep after the Argus Campaign, and he serves them drinks during the meeting.

appearances.role: Member of the House of Nobles; greets Fredrik Farley when King Anduin Wrynn summons him to Stormwind Keep after the Argus Campaign, and serves them drinks during the meeting

1938.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
1938.story: Dalar Dawnweaver is a Forsaken quest giver at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. He was an archmage of the Kirin Tor who was killed in the Scourge attack on Dalaran, raised as one of the Scourge, and then freed by Sylvanas. In Warcraft III: Reforged his name is one of the random enemy archmage heroes who oppose Arthas outside Dalaran while Kel'Thuzad summons Archimonde. In the game he sends adventurers after Archmage Arugal.

appearances.role: One of seven randomly named enemy archmage heroes (six on normal difficulty, all seven on hard) who oppose Arthas outside Dalaran while Kel'Thuzad summons Archimonde (Warcraft III: Reforged only)

246748.name: Archmage Modera
246748.story: Archmage Modera is one of the longest-serving members of the Council of Six, the archmages who rule the Kirin Tor of Dalaran. In WoW Forever, Dalaran has lowered its shield early while the city is still being rebuilt, and you find Modera herself in the Violet Citadel. She welcomes adventurers who have helped the Kirin Tor and tells them that Dalaran owes them at least that much. In the novel Road to Damnation, she sits on the council that warns Kel'Thuzad his necromancy would see them condemned as heretics. In Stormrage, she leads the weary mages of the Violet Citadel against the Emerald Nightmare, and in Jaina Proudmoore: Tides of War she insists that Dalaran stay neutral. In Day of the Dragon she travels with Drenden to meet King Terenas, and in the novella Quest for Pandaria she arrives near Booty Bay with Ansirem Runeweaver to save his daughter Catelyn.

appearances.role: Council of Six member who travels with Drenden to Lordaeron's capital to meet King Terenas and Lord Daval Prestor, the noble rumored to be Deathwing
Sits on the Kirin Tor council that confronts Kel'Thuzad and warns him that his necromancy would see them condemned as heretics
Leads the exhausted mages in the Violet Citadel who hold back the Emerald Nightmare when Malfurion contacts her
Arrives near Booty Bay with Ansirem Runeweaver to save his daughter Catelyn and her crew from the Bloodsail Buccaneers
Insists at the Council of Six that Dalaran stays neutral when Jaina asks for help against Orgrimmar

15457.name: Huntress Swiftriver
15457.story: Huntress Swiftriver is a night elf quest giver in the Military Ward of Ironforge. During the war effort before the Ahn'Qiraj War she gathers spotted yellowtail fish, aiming for 17,000, to feed the soldiers. In the short story The War Effort, the fish that Saegan and Daryl Riknussun prepare are meant for her.

appearances.role: Waits for the fish that Saegan and Daryl Riknussun prepare for the Ahn'Qiraj war effort, which Saegan carries to the Military Ward

2542.name: Catelyn the Blade
2542.story: Catelyn Runeweaver, known as Catelyn the Blade, is a human quest giver in the Salty Sailor Tavern in Booty Bay. She is the best knife fighter in Booty Bay and the daughter of Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver. She joined the Blackwater Raiders as a pirate and became captain of the raider ship Neptulon's Bride. In the book Quest for Pandaria she owes a debt to the Steamwheedle Cartel, steals the Pearl of Pandaria from Li Li Stormstout, and later gives it back.

appearances.role: Steals the Pearl of Pandaria from Li Li Stormstout to pay her debt to the Steamwheedle Cartel, then gives it back

40833.name: Tiala Whitemane
40833.story: Tiala Whitemane is a tauren druid of the Guardians of Hyjal. In the novel Shadows Rising, after the Fourth War, she is still guarding the World Tree with the other druids. The Earthen Ring shaman Yukha negotiates a safe passage for Thrall and his companions to a meeting with Tyrande. Tiala assures her that the passage will stay open. In World of Warcraft: Forever she stands in Mount Hyjal.

appearances.role: Assures Yukha of the Earthen Ring that the druids guarding the World Tree will keep a safe passage open for Thrall to meet Tyrande

2543.name: Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver
2543.story: Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver is a human quest giver located at Dalaran Crater in the Alterac Mountains. He is a member of the Council of Six, the leaders of the Kirin Tor of Dalaran. In Warcraft III: Reforged his name is one of the random enemy archmage heroes who oppose Arthas outside Dalaran while Kel'Thuzad summons Archimonde. In the game he offers the quest Ansirem's Key and completes Magical Analysis. The novel Jaina Proudmoore: Tides of War tells that he stayed at the crater until the Cataclysm and kept serving the Kirin Tor. In the novella Quest for Pandaria he arrives near Booty Bay with other magi to save his daughter Catelyn from the Bloodsail Buccaneers.

appearances.role: One of seven randomly named enemy archmage heroes (six on normal difficulty, all seven on hard) who oppose Arthas outside Dalaran while Kel'Thuzad summons Archimonde (Warcraft III: Reforged only)
Attends Council of Six meetings where Jaina asks for help defending Theramore and attacking Orgrimmar
Arrives near Booty Bay with other magi to save his daughter Catelyn when the Bloodsail Buccaneers attack her crew

269127.name: Image of Archmage Modera
269127.story: Archmage Modera is one of the longest-serving members of the Council of Six, the archmages who rule the Kirin Tor of Dalaran. Before the Third War she spoke out against Kel'Thuzad's necromancy, and she stayed in Dalaran after the Scourge destroyed it. In WoW Forever, Dalaran has lowered its shield early while the city is still being rebuilt, and Modera herself works in the Violet Citadel. Outside the city walls, by the sewer exit pipe in Silverpine Forest, a magical image of her gives adventurers tasks for the Kirin Tor.

appearances.role: Sits on the Kirin Tor council that confronts Kel'Thuzad and warns him that his necromancy would see them condemned as heretics
Leads the exhausted mages in the Violet Citadel who hold back the Emerald Nightmare when Malfurion contacts her
Insists at the Council of Six that Dalaran stays neutral when Jaina asks for help against Orgrimmar

272526.name: Glix Xizzix
272526.story: Glix Xizzix is a goblin trader who led the Xizzix Caravan through Tirisfal Glades while the Forsaken were founding their kingdom. When Rot Hide gnolls stole his wares, he struck a deal with Garek Bandarion and Dark Ranger Anya to get them back. He now does business in the Trade Quarter of the Undercity. He likes to tell anyone who listens that he fed the Undercity and single-handedly armed the resistance during the war with the Scourge.

appearances.role: Goblin merchant whose caravan is robbed by gnolls in Tirisfal Glades; Garek Bandarion and Dark Ranger Anya recover his wares in the optional quest "Highway Robbery"

250660.name: The Baron
250660.story: The Baron is the abomination that was once Othmar Garithos, the bigoted Grand Marshal who led the last human forces of Lordaeron after the Third War. After Sylvanas had him killed, the Forsaken stitched his body into an abomination, and he was cut down and sewn back together several times. By the time of WoW Forever he has gone rogue and roams King's Alley in the Ruins of Lordaeron. Captain Truman, one of his captains in life, still serves him without knowing that both of them are now undead. When adventurers bring the Baron's head to Master Apothecary Faranell, he reveals who the creature really is.

appearances.role: As Grand Marshal Garithos, commands the Alliance remnants at Dalaran, then condemns Kael'thas and his blood elves to death for allying with the naga
Enemy commander under Detheroc's mind control, then Sylvanas' uneasy ally against Balnazzar; she has him killed once Lordaeron's capital falls
His remains are gathered by Garek Bandarion and Dark Ranger Anya and stitched into a new abomination by Apothecary Keever

10435.name: Magistrate Barthilas
10435.story: Barthilas was a young paladin who served under Tirion Fordring at Mardenholde Keep, and the Second War had killed his parents and left him hating orcs. In the novel Of Blood and Honor he oversaw Tirion's prosecution for defending the orc Eitrigg and planned Eitrigg's torture and execution. When Thrall's New Horde attacked Stratholme, an orc speared him in the chest, but he survived and took over Mardenholde after Tirion's exile. He later became Magistrate of Stratholme until Arthas killed him and his people during the Culling. In World of Warcraft he haunts Stratholme as an undead wight in the service of the Scourge.

appearances.role: Tirion Fordring's second at Mardenholde Keep: finds and captures the orc Eitrigg together with Saidan Dathrohan, oversees Tirion's prosecution and plans Eitrigg's torture and execution

10812.name: Grand Crusader Dathrohan
10812.story: Saidan Dathrohan was a knight of Lordaeron and one of the first Knights of the Silver Hand. In the novel Of Blood and Honor he made Stratholme his seat as Lord Commander, and sent his old friend Tirion Fordring to trial for treason. After the Third War the dreadlord Balnazzar possessed his body and used it to lead the Scarlet Crusade as Grand Crusader. In World of Warcraft the possessed Saidan leads the Crimson Legion from the Scarlet Bastion in the ruins of Stratholme.

appearances.role: Lordaeron knight chosen by Archbishop Faol, with Uther, Tirion, Turalyon and Gavinrad, as one of the first Knights of the Silver Hand
As Lord Commander he has his friend Tirion Fordring tried for treason after the orc Eitrigg is captured, and watches the planned execution in Stratholme

10813.name: Balnazzar
10813.story: Balnazzar was one of three dreadlords left in Lordaeron to oversee the Burning Legion's conquest. After Arthas returned from Kalimdor, he and his brothers took the Capital City from him. Sylvanas laid siege to his forces and had Varimathras execute him, but the execution was faked. He then took the body of Saidan Dathrohan and became Grand Crusader of the Scarlet Crusade. In World of Warcraft he is in Stratholme, using that disguise to manipulate the Scarlet Crusade.

appearances.role: Dreadlord villain: with his brothers he seizes the Capital City from Arthas and asks Sylvanas to join the coup; is the final enemy commander in A New Power in Lordaeron

10440.name: Baron Rivendare
10440.story: Baron Titus Rivendare was a rich landowner in Stratholme and a friend of Kel'Thuzad, who convinced him to join the Cult of the Damned, where he became a high-ranking member. In Treachery he oversaw the torture of caged soldiers in the sewers beneath Capital City, and in Vengeance Garek Bandarion killed him in his slaughterhouse. He was raised as a death knight and given control of the burning remains of Stratholme. In World of Warcraft he holds Stratholme against the Scarlet Crusade and coordinates the Lich King's efforts in the Plaguelands.

appearances.role: Boss: reveals himself as a Cult of the Damned traitor in the Capital City sewers and raises captives as ghouls (Treachery); is killed by Garek Bandarion in his Stratholme slaughterhouse (Vengeance)
Boss: Kel'Thuzad's champion in Naxxramas, who fights Garek Bandarion, Anya and Leonid Barthalomew and is raised again

3057.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
3057.story: Cairne was the chieftain of the Bloodhoof tauren, and he met Thrall when the orcs landed in Kalimdor and fought off centaur marauders together with them. He told Thrall about the Oracle in the north, and later pledged the loyalty of the tauren to the Horde. When Baine was kidnapped by centaur, Cairne sank into a deep lethargy until Rexxar rescued his son, and then he joined Rexxar against Admiral Proudmoore. Cairne led his people to Mulgore and secured it as a home for all the tauren tribes, and constructed their first city high atop Thunder Bluff. In World of Warcraft he is the High Chieftain of the united tauren tribes and leads Thunder Bluff.

appearances.role: Allied hero (Tauren Chieftain) fighting beside Thrall; in Landfall and The Long March he tells Thrall about the Oracle, and in all five missions he is on the Horde side

appearances.campaign: The Founding of Durotar (Orc bonus campaign)
appearances.role: Old Hatreds: the grieving chieftain whose aid Rexxar must secure; once Baine is rescued he joins as a Warrior Hero. A Blaze of Glory: hero fighting beside Rexxar against Admiral Proudmoore
Among the first tauren to fall under the Nightmare's sway and into slumber
Main character: killed by Garrosh Hellscream in a mak'gora to the death in the Orgrimmar arena, after Magatha Grimtotem poisoned Garrosh's axe Gorehowl

10439.name: Ramstein the Gorger
10439.story: Ramstein the Gorger is an elite abomination boss in Slaughter Square, in the burning city of Stratholme, where he serves the Scourge. He is stitched together from many corpses and is responsible for the death of thousands, including the ranger lord Nathanos Marris. Nathanos, now the undead Nathanos Blightcaller, hunted him across the Plaguelands for months until Ramstein fled to the safety of Stratholme. In Warcraft III: Reforged, Forsaken Kingdom, he is already in Stratholme when Garek Bandarion and Ilastar Songbreeze enter the city to hunt down Baron Rivendare.

appearances.role: Scourge abomination who stands among the undead forces in Stratholme as Garek Bandarion and Ilastar Songbreeze hunt Baron Rivendare

8140.name: Brother Karman
8140.story: Brother Karman is a human paladin trainer on Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh, just outside Foothold Citadel near the training dummies. He is a member of the Theramore Guard and the Knights of the Silver Hand. In Warcraft III: Reforged his name is the random enemy paladin hero of the Lordaeron Corps, whose base in the Stonetalon Mountains Grom Hellscream's Warsong clan attacks.

appearances.role: One of the randomly named enemy paladin heroes, a member of the Lordaeron Corps defending a human base in the Stonetalon Mountains against Grom Hellscream's Warsong clan (Warcraft III: Reforged only)

928.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
928.story: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker is one of Stormwind's foremost paladins and one of the lords of the Order of the Silver Hand, where he trains young paladins. After the war against the Lich King he took part in the ceremony for the fallen Alliance members in The Shattering. In Blood Ties he took on a new squire, Winthrop. He once lost his right eye in battle.

appearances.role: Silver Hand paladin at the ceremony for the fallen Alliance members of Northrend; at the request of King Varian Wrynn he fetches food and drink for the night elf women who had arrived with news
Gains a new squire, Winthrop, about 42 years after the Dark Portal opened; at Light's Hope Chapel, Winthrop and Arator the Redeemer clean his armor while he speaks with other paladins

8929.name: Princess Moira Bronzebeard
8929.story: Moira Bronzebeard is the daughter of King Magni of Ironforge. While riding to help Lakeshire, she was captured by Dark Iron dwarves in the Burning Steppes and brought to Emperor Dagran Thaurissan in Shadowforge City. She fell in love with him, and when Magni sent a team that killed Dagran she refused to come home and announced that she was pregnant. In the novel The Shattering: Prelude to Cataclysm she returns to Ironforge with her son to claim the throne, and Varian Wrynn spares her at Anduin's plea. In World of Warcraft you meet her in Shadowforge City, in Blackrock Depths.

appearances.role: Returns to Ironforge with her infant son to claim the throne, and is spared by Varian Wrynn when Anduin pleads for her life
Plans to reforge the Hammer of the High King as a symbol of dwarven unity, but is outmaneuvered when Kurdran Wildhammer smashes the Wildhammer piece
Travels to Pandaria for Garrosh Hellscream's trial, where a vision shows how Varian almost executed her
Broods over dwarven politics and her son Dagran's future in Shadowforge City, and tells him the time for learning is over

12939.name: Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen
12939.story: Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen is a human trauma surgeon and the chief physician of Alliance Trauma, a first aid trainer in Foothold Citadel on Theramore Isle. In WoW Forever he gives the Triage quest to adventurers who have come far in their first aid training. He also oversees the training of Theramore's healers. In the novel Jaina Proudmoore: Tides of War, he remains in Theramore when the Horde attacks and, after the Horde has escaped the city, begins healing the injured soldiers.

appearances.role: Stays in Theramore when the Horde attacks and tends the injured soldiers once the Horde has escaped the city

10184.name: Onyxia
10184.story: Onyxia is the daughter of Deathwing and the broodmother of the black dragonflight, and she appears as the Stormwind noblewoman Lady Katrana Prestor. In the novel Beyond the Dark Portal, Deathwing orders her and her brother Nefarian to secure the Blackrock orcs as their new force. She has been seen traveling to and from Blackrock Mountain, but her main lair is a fiery cave below the Dragonmurk. In the short story Visage Day she scorns the bronze dragon Chronormu for choosing a visage to relate to mortals. In World of Warcraft she guards the eggs of her new brood in that lair and will answer any threat with terrible wrath.

appearances.role: Ordered by Deathwing, together with her brother Nefarian, to secure the Blackrock orcs of Blackrock Spire as their new force
Tells the young bronze dragon Chronormu that a mortal visage is a tool to control mortals, then attends his Visage Day ceremony at Wyrmrest Temple

2423.name: Lord Aliden Perenolde
2423.story: In the novel Beyond the Dark Portal, Aliden is the eldest son of King Aiden Perenolde and crown prince of Alterac. King Terenas of Lordaeron thought him pampered and inexperienced, but admitted that the Alliance had no right to deny him the throne if his father abdicated, since he was the legal heir. He spent two years trying to overcome the stigma of his father's betrayal in the Second War. When he saw that his father had traded the Book of Medivh to the Horde, he punched him and said he had ruined everything. In World of Warcraft he leads the Syndicate from Dandred's Fold, and Horde adventurers kill him on Krusk's orders.

appearances.role: Crown prince of Alterac whom the Alliance leaders discuss as heir in chapter 7; in chapter 10 he punches his father Aiden for trading the Book of Medivh to the Horde

10162.name: Lord Victor Nefarius
10162.story: Lord Victor Nefarius is the human guise of the black dragon Nefarian, eldest son of Deathwing. In the novel Beyond the Dark Portal, Deathwing orders Nefarian and his sister Onyxia to secure the Blackrock orcs as their new force. Nefarian then comes to Blackrock Spire and takes command of Rend and Maim Blackhand and their forces. In World of Warcraft this guise is known as the Lord of Blackrock, who holds the Blackrock clan and various clans of ogres under his control.

appearances.role: Human guise of the dragon Nefarian, who is sent by Deathwing to Blackrock Spire and takes command of the Blackhand brothers

5087.name: Do'gol
5087.story: Do'gol is an ogre of the Stonemaul clan. In Warcraft III: Reforged he appears in the ogre village in Dustwallow Marsh during Old Hatreds, the mission in which Rexxar seeks the ogres' help. In World of Warcraft he is a quest giver in Brackenwall Village, Dustwallow Marsh. There he takes part in parts two to four of the Black Shield quest chain.

appearances.campaign: The Founding of Durotar (Orc bonus campaign)
appearances.role: Stonemaul ogre present in the ogre village in Dustwallow Marsh (Warcraft III: Reforged only)

15379.name: Caelestrasz
15379.story: In World of Warcraft, Caelestrasz waits in the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj and gives the quest The Savior of Kalimdor. In the short story The War of the Shifting Sands, Anachronos calls on the red dragonflight's progeny, Caelestrasz, to fight the qiraji. He, Merithra and Arygos fly into the city to hold the qiraji back while the barrier is raised, and are overwhelmed when the qiraji surge forth.

appearances.campaign: The War of the Shifting Sands
appearances.role: Charges into Ahn'Qiraj with Merithra and Arygos to hold the qiraji back while the barrier is raised, and is overwhelmed

2425.name: Varimathras
2425.story: Varimathras was one of three dreadlords who ruled Lordaeron after Arthas left for Northrend. He secretly made a deal with Sylvanas to overthrow Arthas, and put his own life above the nathrezim code by attacking his brother Balnazzar. On Sylvanas' order he killed Lord Garithos, securing his place among the Forsaken. After the Undercity was founded, he tasked Garek Bandarion and Dark Ranger Anya with putting together a city guard that later became the basis of the Deathguard. In World of Warcraft he stands at Sylvanas' side in the Royal Quarter.

appearances.role: Enemy hero (Dreadlord): in the A Kingdom Divided interlude he and his brothers tell Sylvanas the Lich King is losing his power; offers her a place in the dreadlords' new order, then begs for his life and defects to her
Playable hero (Dreadlord)
Quest NPC: the player reports to him
Appears in Sylvanas' Emerald Nightmare dream, where he torments her alongside Arthas (chapter 18)
Named by Sylvanas as the one who must supply Putress with whatever he needs for the New Plague (chapter 15)

appearances.campaign: Arthas: Rise of the Lich King
appearances.role: Sylvanas tells him that something has happened with the Lich King and that their plans must be stepped up

15341.name: General Rajaxx
15341.story: General Rajaxx is a primary militant commander of the qiraji. In the short story The War of the Shifting Sands, he leads the qiraji and silithid in battle against the night elves and tears Valstann Staghelm in two with his claws. In World of Warcraft he is the second boss of the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj. Adventurers must first defeat seven waves of his officers and their swarms before they reach him.

appearances.campaign: The War of the Shifting Sands
appearances.role: Commands the qiraji and silithid against the night elves, clashes with Fandral and Valstann Staghelm and personally kills Valstann

9598.name: Arei
9598.story: In World of Warcraft Arei appears in Irontree Woods in Felwood when you play the Flute of the Ancients. You then escort his spirit through the corrupted woods. In the novel Stormrage he battles the Emerald Nightmare from within the Emerald Dream alongside Zaetar and other guardians of nature.

appearances.role: Ancient of War who fights the Emerald Nightmare from inside the Emerald Dream, finds Broll Bearmantle there and leads him to Zaetar

15989.name: Sapphiron
15989.story: Sapphiron was an ancient blue dragon who lived with his brood near the entrance to Azjol-Nerub in Northrend, guarding a hoard of artifacts. When Arthas and Anub'arak came to take the hoard, he fought them and was killed. Arthas raised him as a frost wyrm to serve the Scourge. In World of Warcraft he guards the Frostwyrm Lair in Naxxramas, the approach to the chamber of Kel'Thuzad. His frost magic, strengthened when Arthas raised him, defends Kel'Thuzad at all costs.

appearances.role: Blue dragon who guards a hoard of artifacts and fights Arthas and Anub'arak, then is raised as a frost wyrm and breaks the dwarves' gate to Azjol-Nerub

1855.name: Tirion Fordring
1855.story: Tirion Fordring was governor of Hearthglen and a hero of the Second War until he was stripped of his titles and excommunicated from the Knights of the Silver Hand. In Of Blood and Honor he rides to Stratholme to save the orc Eitrigg from execution, and the two escape together into the wilds. Years later he lives in exile in a cottage on the shores of the Thondroril River in the Eastern Plaguelands, with his horse Mirador. In the novel Arthas: Rise of the Lich King he is present when Arthas becomes a paladin in Stormwind.

appearances.role: Studies under Archbishop Alonsus Faol and is chosen with Uther, Saidan, Turalyon and Gavinrad as one of the first knights of the Silver Hand (chapter 5)
Rides to Stratholme to free Eitrigg from execution and flees with him into the wilds (chapters 6-7)

appearances.campaign: Arthas: Rise of the Lich King
appearances.role: Attends Arthas's induction as a paladin in Stormwind

10666.name: Gordo
10666.story: Some time after the Forsaken established the Undercity, Gordo served at a camp northwest of the Capital City Ruins. He wandered into the forest to collect goods and did not return, so Melisara sent Garek Bandarion and Dark Ranger Anya to find him. They freed him from a spider web, and he returned to camp. In World of Warcraft he wanders the road between Deathknell and Brill looking for gloom weed for Junior Apothecary Holland.

appearances.role: Optional quest NPC (abomination): the player finds and frees him from a spider den and returns him to Melisara

11946.name: Drek'Thar
11946.story: Drek'Thar was a shaman of the Frostwolf clan who followed the warlocks for a time on Draenor, then renounced them and led the clan after Durotan's death. In the novel Lord of the Clans he discovers that Thrall is Durotan's heir and trains him in the ways of the shaman. After the Third War he crossed the sea to help Thrall found Durotar, and in The Founding of Durotar he sends Rexxar to gather shimmerweed. In World of Warcraft he leads the Frostwolf clan from Frostwolf Keep in Alterac Valley and commands the Horde in the battle against the Stormpike Guard. He still carries guilt over the early days of the Horde.

appearances.campaign: The Founding of Durotar (Orc bonus campaign)
appearances.role: Quest giver and ally: sends Rexxar for shimmerweed in Thunder Ridge, then joins him to find out why the thunder lizards turned hostile
Frostwolf shaman who accepts Ner'zhul's word that the draenei are plotting against the orcs, and later shares the Frostwolves' exile into the Alterac Mountains
Farseer who takes Thrall under his wing, trains him as a shaman and sets up his meeting with Orgrim Doomhammer
Elderly and increasingly senile, he has visions of an attack on a peace meeting of druids and of the world breaking apart, and pleads with Palkar to send warnings

3066.name: Narm Skychaser
3066.story: Narm Skychaser is a tauren shaman trainer in Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore, and he directs shaman adventurers to Kranal Fiss. In The Shattering: Prelude to Cataclysm, he was killed by the Grimtotem tribe following Cairne Bloodhoof's death. After Cairne was killed, Magatha Grimtotem ordered her tribe to attack Thunder Bluff and the other tauren towns.

appearances.role: Victim: killed by the Grimtotem tribe after Cairne Bloodhoof's death

466.name: General Marcus Jonathan
466.story: General Marcus Jonathan was the high commander of Stormwind Defense. During the War Against the Nightmare in Stormrage he sent Major Mattingly for reinforcements. In the short story Blood of Our Fathers he organized the search for King Varian when the king went missing before his Remembrance Day speech. In Jaina Proudmoore: Tides of War he organized the defense of Theramore Isle and was killed when the Horde detonated a mana bomb to destroy the city.

appearances.role: High Commander of Stormwind Defense; during the War Against the Nightmare he sends Major Mattingly to King Varian Wrynn for reinforcements as the mists seize the Valley of Heroes
Orders Field Marshal Afrasiabi to stall the crowds while he organizes a search for the missing King Varian, then helps Jaina Proudmoore find the king dying and sees Anduin heal him
First to accept King Wrynn's call to support Theramore Isle; he is the main organizer of its defense and is killed when the Horde detonates a mana bomb about 30 years after the Dark Portal opened

482.name: Elling Trias
482.story: Elling Trias runs Trias' Cheese in the Trade District with his wife Elaine and son Ben, but he is more than a cheesemaker and has contacts from SI:7 to Hearthglen. In the audio short story The Tipping Point, Mathias Shaw meets him in the cellar beneath his shop to plan how to protect SI:7's informants in Undermine, and later gives Renzik a coin to show the master of cheese if he ever comes to Stormwind. In World of Warcraft he is a contact in quest chains such as The Missing Diplomat, and he orders the killing of the traitor Lord Gregor Lescovar.

appearances.role: Meets Mathias Shaw in the cellar beneath Trias' Cheese to plan the protection of SI:7's informants in Undermine; Shaw tells Renzik to show a coin to him as the "master of cheese"

11186.name: Lunnix Sprocketslip
11186.story: Lunnix Sprocketslip, nicknamed Lunny, is a goblin mining vendor in Everlook in Winterspring. In the novel Before the Storm, Kezzig Klackwhistle works for her in her mining supply shop, and the two enter a relationship. She ends it once she catches Kezzig hanging around Gogo, and her anger drives Kezzig to leave Everlook for Silithus. In World of Warcraft she sells mining supplies in Everlook.

appearances.role: Ends her relationship with Kezzig Klackwhistle after she catches him hanging around Gogo

3916.name: Shael'dryn
3916.story: Shael'dryn is a dryad quest giver in Ashenvale who considers herself a comedian; Broll Bearmantle calls her a jester of words and a lover of puns. In the novel Stormrage, when the Emerald Nightmare attacks Azeroth, she warns the other guardians about shadow attackers. She then becomes a sleeping victim of the attack herself.

appearances.role: Dryad guardian who warns the other guardians about the shadow attackers of the Emerald Nightmare, then falls asleep herself (chapter 11)

2707.name: Shadra
2707.story: Elortha no Shadra, the spider loa, is worshipped by the Witherbark and Vilebranch tribes in the Hinterlands. In World of Warcraft Horde adventurers summon her at an altar, where she is killed and her venom is sent to the Undercity. In the novel Traveler: The Spiral Path the Sandfury trolls call on her at Zul'Farrak to judge their captives, but she refuses to claim the dryad Taryndrella and Murky. In the novel Vol'jin: Shadows of the Horde she communicates with Vol'jin through visions shortly after the Landfall.

appearances.role: Spider loa Elortha no Shadra who refuses to claim the captive Taryndrella and Murky when the Sandfury trolls prepare to sacrifice them at Zul'Farrak
Communicates with Vol'jin through visions shortly after the Landfall

1156.name: Vyrin Swiftwind
1156.story: Vyrin Swiftwind is a high elf married to Talithar Swiftwind, though the two became estranged after the fall of the high elves following the Third War. Talithar embraced the teachings of Prince Kael'thas for the sake of his people, while Vyrin chose her integrity and went to live at the Farstrider Lodge. In the novella Quest for Pandaria, Talithar helps the dwarf Baenan escape the Horde destroyer Warchief's Fist and asks him to give Vyrin their wedding rings with the message that he never stopped loving her. Talithar later sacrificed himself to save Baenan and Chen Stormstout, and Baenan chose to name him a hero. In World of Warcraft she is a quest giver at the Farstrider Lodge in Loch Modan.

appearances.role: Talithar Swiftwind's estranged wife, who tells the dwarf Baenan of her longing for her husband; Talithar asks Baenan to bring her their wedding rings

10429.name: Warchief Rend Blackhand
10429.story: At the end of the Second War, Rend and his brother Maim took control of Blackrock Mountain, and Rend declared himself Warchief of the weakened Blackrock clan. They blamed Orgrim Doomhammer for the Horde's defeat and planned to reforge the Horde as they saw fit. In the novel Beyond the Dark Portal Rend refused to rejoin Ner'zhul's Horde, and Nefarian then took command of the Blackhand brothers and their forces. In World of Warcraft he rules the Dark Horde from the arena of Upper Blackrock Spire, rides the chromatic drake Gyth and wants to overthrow Thrall.

appearances.role: Lieutenant to Warchief Orgrim Doomhammer; he and his brother Maim question Orgrim's orders but never disobey them
Laughs off Teron Gorefiend's request to rejoin Ner'zhul's Horde, then falls under Nefarian's command when the dragon arrives at Blackrock Spire

1284.name: Archbishop Benedictus
1284.story: Archbishop Benedictus was the leader of the Church of the Holy Light and succeeded Archbishop Alonsus Faol before the Third War. The fall of Lordaeron and the appearance of the Scourge pushed his faith to the breaking point. In The Shattering he led the memorial service at the Cathedral of Light for the fallen of the war against the Lich King. In the short story Blood of Our Fathers he counsels King Varian and gives him the key to Queen Tiffin's locket, shortly before Twilight's Hammer assassins attack. In the novel Thrall: Twilight of the Aspects he is the Twilight Father, the leader of the Twilight's Hammer.

appearances.role: Leader of the Church of the Holy Light in Stormwind; leads the memorial service at the Cathedral of Light for the fallen of the war against the Lich King (chapter 6)
Counsels King Varian on Remembrance Day and gives him the key to Queen Tiffin's locket at her grave, shortly before Twilight's Hammer assassins attack
As the Twilight Father, leads the Twilight's Hammer at Wyrmrest Temple, captures the blue dragon Kirygosa, and is cast down when Chromatus falls

3453.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
3453.story: Wharfmaster Dizzywig is a goblin dockmaster in Ratchet in the Barrens. In the novel Night of the Dragon he provided transport for Velinde Starsong, and later for Iridi when she came through Ratchet to purchase a boat. In World of Warcraft he runs the docks of Ratchet and gives quests such as Southsea Freebooters and Passage to Booty Bay.

appearances.role: Provides boat transport to the night elf Velinde Starsong, and later to the draenei Iridi when she comes through Ratchet to buy a boat

11710.name: Mirador
11710.story: Mirador is the faithful stallion of Tirion Fordring. In World of Warcraft he stands outside Tirion's cottage beside the Thondroril River in the Eastern Plaguelands. In the novella Of Blood and Honor he carries the wounded Tirion home after his duel with Eitrigg, and later carries him to Stratholme to save the orc.

appearances.role: Carries the wounded Tirion Fordring back to Mardenholde after his duel with Eitrigg, then carries him to Stratholme to save Eitrigg from execution (chapters 2 and 6-7)

10182.name: Rexxar
10182.story: Thrall named Rexxar Champion of the Horde and let him lead the attack on Admiral Daelin Proudmoore's forces at Theramore. Rexxar named the ogre Mok'Morokk the new leader of the Stonemaul clan, a decision he would later regret. Thrall invited him to Durotar, but Rexxar said his place was still in the wild, though he would always be part of the Horde. In World of Warcraft he wanders the wilds of Kalimdor with his bear Misha, on a path from the Stonetalon Mountains through Desolace to Feralas.

appearances.campaign: The Founding of Durotar (Orc bonus campaign)
appearances.role: Main playable hero (Beastmaster); the Mok'nathal who helps Thrall secure Durotar
Beastmaster who finds the wounded orc Byrok with his bear Misha and brings him to Thrall in Orgrimmar, where Byrok tells Thrall about the Burning Blade clan
Horde beastmaster; the novel describes him as a half-ogre (chapter 14)

4092.name: Lariia
4092.story: Lariia is a night elf priestess of the Sisterhood of Elune and the priest trainer in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. In the novella Elegy, she is in the temple during the Burning of Teldrassil. Astarii Starseeker sends her to see how far the fire has spread, so she dips herself in the temple's pool and goes outside. She returns to report that everything is burning and that the roads into the city are blocked by fire. The last three priestesses decide to stay in the temple as the city burns, and Lariia dies there.

appearances.role: Priestess of the Moon who scouts the burning city for Astarii Starseeker and reports the roads blocked, then stays in the Temple of the Moon with the last priestesses

6807.name: Innkeeper Skindle
6807.story: Innkeeper Skindle is a goblin innkeeper in the Salty Sailor Tavern in Booty Bay. He sells food and drink to travelers in the inn. In the book Quest for Pandaria, Chen Stormstout pays him some coins and Skindle tells him everything about Catelyn.

appearances.role: Tells Chen Stormstout everything about Catelyn after Chen pays him

2547.name: Ironpatch
2547.story: Ironpatch is an orc member of the Bloodsail Buccaneers, found on the pirate ship The Crimson Veil off the southern coast of Stranglethorn Vale. Killing him earns reputation with Booty Bay and costs reputation with the Bloodsail Buccaneers. In the book Traveler: The Spiral Path he is the captain of the Killmonger and attacks the Sea King of the Blackwater Raiders. He executes its captain, Adashe Flintwill, and is finally killed by Makasa Flintwill with Adashe's harpoon.

appearances.role: Attacks the Sea King with the Killmonger and executes its captain, Adashe Flintwill

2496.name: Baron Revilgaz
2496.story: Baron Revilgaz rules the goblin port of Booty Bay, home of the Blackwater Raiders, and he watches over the harbor from his balcony atop the Salty Sailor Tavern with Fleet Master Seahorn at his side. In the short story Stranglethorn Fishing Extravaganza, the wars in Alterac Valley and Warsong Gulch have drawn visitors away from Stranglethorn and business is struggling. He first refuses a loan to the angler Riggle Bassbait. Then he tastes Riggle's tastyfish and agrees to a fishing tournament that brings adventurers and trade back to Booty Bay.

appearances.role: Hears Riggle Bassbait's loan request, is won over by his tastyfish, and agrees to a fishing tournament that brings visitors back to Booty Bay

7917.name: Brother Sarno
7917.story: Brother Sarno is a member of the Church of the Holy Light located in the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind City, where he is the first to greet those who enter. After the war against the Lich King, the cathedral held a ceremony for the fallen. In The Shattering he exchanged smiles and nods with Prince Anduin Wrynn at that ceremony.

appearances.role: Cathedral of Light priest; when Anduin Wrynn arrives at the cathedral's ceremony for the fallen of the war against the Lich King, they exchange smiles and nods

15077.name: Riggle Bassbait
15077.story: Riggle Bassbait is a goblin angler who stands on a dock in Booty Bay, where he runs the Stranglethorn Fishing Extravaganza and takes the speckled tastyfish that anglers turn in to him. He appears for the weekly Stranglethorn Fishing Extravaganza, which is held on Sunday afternoons. In the short story Stranglethorn Fishing Extravaganza, he rows into Booty Bay and asks Baron Revilgaz for a loan to fund his plan. Revilgaz first refuses, but after tasting Riggle's tastyfish he agrees to a fishing tournament, and Riggle goes off to seed the coastal waters with fish.

appearances.role: Asks Baron Revilgaz for a loan to fund a fishing tournament, wins him over with a plate of tastyfish, and then goes off to seed the coastal waters with fish for the contest

2055.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
2055.story: Before the Scourge, Faranell was an alchemist of great renown who studied with the wizards of Dalaran, and he rose as one of the Forsaken. In Sylvanas he served as a subordinate of Grand Apothecary Putress and became one of the foremost experts on the undead plague. In Arthas: Rise of the Lich King, on Putress' orders, he showed the effects of the New Plague by having two prisoners drink it, and Sylvanas was pleased but warned that the blight must never fall into the wrong hands. In World of Warcraft he is the Master of the Apothecarium in the Undercity.

appearances.campaign: Arthas: Rise of the Lich King
appearances.role: Grand Apothecary Putress' apothecary who demonstrates the New Plague to Sylvanas with two prisoners
Subordinate of Grand Apothecary Putress

16063.name: Sir Zeliek
16063.story: Sir Zeliek is one of the Four Horsemen of Naxxramas and was a paladin of the Order of the Silver Hand in life. Even in undeath the power of the Light still answers his call. Kel'Thuzad forces his body to obey, but Zeliek keeps his sanity and morals, which makes him a tragic figure forced to slay what he once held dear. In World of Warcraft he stands in Naxxramas above Stratholme with the other horsemen, overseeing the Military Quarter. In Forsaken Kingdom the Forsaken strike team kills him, but Leonid notes that the Scourge will simply resurrect him.

appearances.role: Scourge death knight and former paladin who fights Garek, Anya and Leonid inside Naxxramas and prays for the Light to destroy him so he is freed from his master (Warcraft III: Reforged only)

16376.name: Craftsman Wilhelm
16376.story: Craftsman Wilhelm is a dwarf blacksmith vendor at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands, affiliated with the Brotherhood of the Light. In the novel Blood Ties he usually repairs the weapons and armor of the paladins of the Order of the Silver Hand. In the same book he keeps working at his forge and drinks Thunderbrew lager while Arator the Redeemer visits him.

appearances.role: Works at his forge at Light's Hope Chapel while Arator the Redeemer visits him

11036.name: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered
11036.story: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered is an undead member of the Argent Dawn who was raised as a mindless thrall of the Scourge before Sylvanas Windrunner freed him. In World of Warcraft he stands at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands and helps adventurers deal with Ras Frostwhisper. Later he tricks Tinkee Steamboil into sending the adventurers back to him with frozen black dragon eggs, then has them deliver the eggs to Betina Bigglezink. In the Forsaken Kingdom campaign of Warcraft III Reforged he helps Garek Bandarion and Dark Ranger Anya destroy the central crystal of Naxxramas.

appearances.role: Helps Garek Bandarion and Dark Ranger Anya take Dawn's Watch from the Crushridge clan, then destroys the central crystal of Naxxramas with them

10204.name: Misha
10204.story: Misha fought at Rexxar's side in the battle against Lord Admiral Daelin Proudmoore at Theramore Isle. When Rexxar turned down Thrall's offer and returned to the wild, Misha went with him. In World of Warcraft she follows her master along the road from the Stonetalon Mountains through Desolace to Feralas.

appearances.campaign: The Founding of Durotar (Orc bonus campaign)
appearances.role: Rexxar's bear companion, summoned with his "Summon Misha" ability
Rexxar's bear, who helps him find the wounded orc Byrok and carry him to Orgrimmar

3205.name: Zalazane
3205.story: In the short story The Judgment, Zalazane grew up as the best friend of Vol'jin, who was the son of the Darkspear chieftain Sen'jin. The two young trolls were tested by the loa at First Home, and Zalazane became a witch doctor under Master Gadrin. In World of Warcraft he became the Hexmaster and Traitor of the Darkspears, and used dark voodoo to rob most of the Darkspear trolls of their free will. He declared himself ruler of the Echo Isles, and the Darkspears and their allies often struck at his holdings there.

appearances.role: Vol'jin's childhood best friend; he joins Vol'jin in First Home to be tested by the loa and emerges a witch doctor

11034.name: Lord Maxwell Tyrosus
11034.story: Lord Maxwell Tyrosus leads the Argent Dawn from Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands. He plans with Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff an offensive on Stratholme to eliminate Baron Rivendare. In the novel Blood Ties he turns down Arator the Redeemer's bid for promotion, but later inducts three new paladins into the Silver Hand. In the Forsaken Kingdom campaign of Warcraft III Reforged he leads the Argent Dawn forces at Dawn's Watch when the Crushridge clan attacks.

appearances.role: Leads the Argent Dawn forces at Dawn's Watch, which the Crushridge clan attacks until Garek, Anya and Leonid liberate it
Turns down Arator the Redeemer's request for promotion at Light's Hope Chapel, then inducts three new paladins into the order

10824.name: Ranger Lord Hawkspear
10824.story: Renthar Hawkspear led the hunters of Quel'Lithien Lodge in the Eastern Plaguelands as a high elf ranger lord. In World of Warcraft he is a rare ranger found south of the lodge. In the novel World of Warcraft: Sylvanas he and the other Farstriders investigate the deaths of Lireesa and Verath Windrunner. In the short story In the Shadow of the Sun he turns down Lor'themar Theron's offer of aid and tells him the lodge's quel'dorei were banished from Quel'Thalas.

appearances.role: Leads the hunters of Quel'Lithien Lodge and investigates the slaying of Lireesa and Verath Windrunner with the Farstriders

appearances.campaign: In the Shadow of the Sun
appearances.role: Refuses Lor'themar Theron's aid and reveals that the Regent Lord banished the lodge's quel'dorei

3188.name: Master Gadrin
3188.story: Master Gadrin is an elderly jungle troll and the chief witch doctor of the Darkspear tribe, based in Sen'jin Village in Durotar. He was the mentor of Vol'jin and Zalazane, and after they returned from First Home he told them about the death of Sen'jin. In World of Warcraft he sends adventurers to retrieve Minshina's skull in the Echo Isles and to fight Zalazane's minions. In the novel Before the Storm he stood beside Baine Bloodhoof at Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff.

appearances.role: Mentor of Vol'jin and Zalazane: after their return from First Home he tells them they were gone three months, confirms the death of Sen'jin and takes over the evacuation
Present at Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff beside Baine Bloodhoof when Magni Bronzebeard arrives to speak about healing Azeroth (chapter 12)

5387.name: High Explorer Magellas
5387.story: High Explorer Muninn Magellas leads the Explorers' League from the Library of the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge. He maps the world and catalogues its relics for the dwarves, and he is excited when an adventurer brings him platinum discs from Uldaman. In the novel The Shattering, he tries to decipher the phrases of a tablet from Ulduar and translates the unknown language of Magni's ritual in Old Ironforge for Anduin Wrynn. In the novel Before the Storm, he agrees to send a team from the Explorers' League to Silithus after Magni speaks about Azerite.

appearances.role: Head of the Explorers' League who tries to decipher the tablet from Ulduar and translates the unknown language of Magni's ritual for Anduin Wrynn
Meets Magni Bronzebeard in the Hall of Explorers and agrees to send an Explorers' League team to Silithus to study Azerite (chapter 8)

2918.name: Advisor Belgrum
2918.story: Advisor Belgrum is a dwarf and a member of the Explorers' League. As an advisor to Magni Bronzebeard, he gives orders on the King's authority. In World of Warcraft he stands in the Library of the Hall of Explorers, where he acts on Historian Karnik's warning about the Shadowforge dwarves in Uldaman and sends adventurers back for the Tablet of Will. In the novel The Shattering, he fills in as head of Ironforge's government for a while after Magni turns to stone.

appearances.role: Explorers' League dwarf who helps Muninn Magellas decipher the tablet from Ulduar, speaks at Magni's ritual and fills in as head of Ironforge's government after Magni is petrified

5635.name: Falstad Wildhammer
5635.story: Falstad Wildhammer is the High Thane of the Wildhammer clan at Aerie Peak in the Hinterlands. In World of Warcraft he was a quest giver at Aerie Peak, where he dealt with the encroaching forest trolls. In the novel Day of the Dragon he leads gryphon riders who protect Hasic and carry Rhonin's group across the Great Sea to Khaz Modan. In the novel Stormrage he attends the wedding of Malfurion and Tyrande, and in War Crimes he attends Garrosh's trial. In the novel Before the Storm he welcomes King Anduin Wrynn to Ironforge as a member of the Council of Three Hammers.

appearances.role: Leads a flight of gryphon riders that protects Hasic, then transports Rhonin and his companions across the Great Sea to Khaz Modan
Attends the wedding of Malfurion Stormrage and Tyrande Whisperwind after the War Against the Nightmare
Sits on the Council of Three Hammers that cannot help Li Li Stormstout find Magni, and laughs at how rude she is
Attends the trial of Garrosh Hellscream in the Temple of the White Tiger with his fellow Council of Three Hammers members
Welcomes King Anduin Wrynn to Ironforge as a member of the Council of Three Hammers

3329.name: Kor'jus
3329.story: In the novel Jaina Proudmoore: Tides of War, Malkorok and a few Kor'kron soldiers attacked Kor'jus when his shop was closed, because he was not fully supportive of Garrosh Hellscream. They arrested and beat him, and he returned to his shop after a few days. In the novel War Crimes, he was called as the second witness at Garrosh's trial. In World of Warcraft he is a Mushroom Vendor in Orgrimmar.

appearances.role: Shopkeeper arrested and beaten by Malkorok and Kor'kron soldiers for not fully supporting Garrosh Hellscream
Called as the second witness at Garrosh's trial, where the court sees Malkorok's attack on him in a vision

14720.name: High Overlord Saurfang
14720.story: Varok Saurfang was a renowned Blackrock orc warrior, the younger brother of Broxigar, and second-in-command to Warchief Orgrim Doomhammer. In the novel The Shattering: Prelude to Cataclysm, Cairne Bloodhoof traveled to Warsong Hold to meet Garrosh, and Saurfang was to stay there as leader of the Warsong Offensive and the Horde Expedition. In World of Warcraft he is High Overlord Saurfang, leader of the Kor'kron Guard, and during the war against Ahn'Qiraj he is Supreme Commander of the Might of Kalimdor.

appearances.role: Remains at Warsong Hold as leader of the Warsong Offensive and the Horde Expedition after Cairne Bloodhoof visits Garrosh
Goes with Go'el and Eitrigg to Garrosh's trial, agrees with Baine as defender, and testifies as Tyrande's third witness about his conflicts with Garrosh in Northrend
Leads the Horde's attack on Darnassus in the War of the Thorns, lets Malfurion and Tyrande go, and watches Sylvanas burn Teldrassil

4507.name: Daisy
4507.story: Daisy was originally the race starter girl at the Mirage Raceway in the Shimmering Flats in Thousand Needles. In the novel Traveler: The Spiral Path, set after the Cataclysm, Aram meets her at the Speedbarge and learns that winning the Annual Fizzle and Pozzik's Speedbarge Boat Race earns permission to salvage the flooded wrecks. She is a singer and a friend of Rendow, and she also races and pilots boats at the Speedbarge.

appearances.role: Racer, boat pilot and singer at the Speedbarge and a friend of Rendow; Aram meets her in chapter 24 and learns that winning the annual boat race earns salvage rights

576.name: Watcher Ladimore
576.story: Sarah Ladimore is the daughter of Morgan Ladimore and the only survivor of her family. She became a Watcher of the Night Watch. In Terror by Torchlight, by which time she had succeeded Althea Ebonlocke as Commander of the Watch, she was found mortally wounded after confronting the Necromancer, and Mathias Shaw and Flynn Fairwind recovered the Torch of Holy Flame.

appearances.role: Commander of the Night Watch in the short story: found mortally wounded after confronting the Necromancer who stole the Torch of Holy Flame in the Forlorn Rowe; later thanks Shaw and Fairwind at the Scarlet Raven Tavern

5144.name: Bink
5144.story: Bink is a gnome mage trainer in the Hall of Mysteries in Ironforge, and the sister of the mage trainer Dink. In The Shattering: Prelude to Cataclysm, Dark Iron guards catch Bink and Dink when Moira Thaurissan arrives in Ironforge. They are released when Ironforge dwarves attack the guards.

appearances.role: Gnome mage, sister of Dink, who is caught by Dark Iron guards when Moira Thaurissan arrives in Ironforge and is released when Ironforge dwarves attack them

2492.name: Lexington Mortaim
2492.story: Lexington Mortaim is a Forsaken mage and portal trainer in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity. He teaches level 40 mages the Portal to Undercity, and tells non-mages they lack the mental acuity to grasp portal magic. In Warcraft III: Reforged, Forsaken Kingdom, he wants the Forsaken to benefit from studying a relic left in the abandoned Arcane Sanctuary of the Capital City ruins.

appearances.role: Optional quest giver (Relic Raiders): believes a powerful artifact remains in the Arcane Sanctuary and asks the player to retrieve it for study
